战斗结束了。那位曾在星海中灵活穿梭的驱逐舰娘终於倒在了我们舰队的集火之下。她那娇小(相对而言)的身躯上布满了灼烧的痕迹，破损的舾装还在不断漏出冷却液，毫无生气地漂浮在太空中，我们的工程师迫不及待地登上了她的残骸。在那已经失去光泽的舾装中，我们找到了大量技术资料，关於如何在巨大的身躯上维持惊人的机动性，如何用动能武器发挥出毁灭性的威力，以及那些绑在她大腿上的鱼雷发射管的设计蓝图。

§G解锁随机一种§MBruh驱逐舰娘§!图纸§!

§Y需要研发配件才会显示在设计器里§!
translation:
The battle is over. The Destroyer shipgirl, who once maneuvered nimbly through the sea of stars, has finally fallen under the concentrated fire of our fleet. Her petite (relatively speaking) body is covered in scorch marks, and her damaged rigging is constantly leaking coolant as she drifts lifelessly in space. Our engineers rushed to board her wreckage. Within that now-lustreless rigging, we found a wealth of technical data: how to maintain incredible maneuverability on a massive body, how to unleash devastating power with kinetic weapons, and the design blueprints for the torpedo tubes strapped to her thighs.

§GUnlocked a random §MBruh Destroyer Shipgirl§! blueprint!§!

§YComponents must be researched before they appear in the designer!§!

original:
这是一场艰苦的战斗。那位战列舰娘直到最後一刻还在开火，她肩上的主炮在熄灭前轰出了最後一发炮弹，将我们三艘主力舰送进了历史。但最终她还是倒下了。在她那已经冷却的身躯中，我们还找到了一本笔记。里面记录着她对每一场战斗的感想，对每一次开火的校正数据，以及...对家乡的思念。原来她也曾是某个文明培养出的守护者。

§G解锁随机一种§MBruh战列舰娘§!图纸§!

§Y需要研发配件才会显示在设计器里§!
translation:
This was a grueling battle. The Battleship shipgirl was still firing until the very last moment; before going dark, her shoulder-mounted main battery unleashed one final shell, sending three of our capital ships into history. But ultimately, she fell. Within her cooled body, we also found a notebook. It recorded her reflections on every battle, calibration data for every shot, and... a longing for home. It turns out she too was once a guardian cultivated by some civilization.

§GUnlocked a random §MBruh Battleship Shipgirl§! blueprint!§!

§YComponents must be researched before they appear in the designer!§!

original:
我们做到了。付出了惨痛的代价後，我们击败了那位曾让整个星区为之颤抖的无畏舰娘。当她那比恒星还要巨大的身躯终於停止挣扎时，整个战场陷入了诡异的寂静。没有人敢第一个靠近她。那些曾经吞噬过星球的唇瓣，那双能够徒手捏碎战舰的玉手，那柄削铁如泥的斩舰刀...即使在死亡面前，她依然散发着令人窒息的威压。花了整整一个月，我们才完成对她屍体的初步勘探。我们发现了她的记忆数据。原来在变成这样的存在之前，她也曾是个普通的少女，是某种我们无法理解的技术将她改造成了这样的「武器」。在记忆的最後，一个想法闪过了她的脑海中。"我已经记不清自己的名字了，但我还记得...我曾经也想要被温柔对待......"
§V(研究团队陷入了长久的沉默)§!

§G解锁随机一种§MBruh无畏舰娘§!图纸§!

§Y需要研发配件才会显示在设计器里§!
translation:
We did it. After paying a tragic price, we defeated the Dreadnought Shipgirl who once made the entire sector tremble. When her body—larger than a star—finally stopped struggling, the entire battlefield fell into an eerie silence. No one dared to be the first to approach her. Those lips that once swallowed planets, those jade hands capable of crushing warships with bare strength, that ship-slaying blade that cut metal like butter... even in death, she still radiated an overwhelming pressure. It took an entire month to complete the preliminary exploration of her remains. We discovered her memory data. It turns out that before becoming such an existence, she too was just an ordinary girl; some technology beyond our understanding had transformed her into this 'weapon'. At the very end of her memories, a thought flashed through her mind: "I can no longer remember my name, but I remember... I once wanted to be treated with tenderness..." 
§V(The research team fell into a long silence)§! 

§GUnlocked a random §MBruh Dreadnought Shipgirl§! blueprint§!

We must immediately hand over another batch of our compatriots; they will leave our cities forever—cities that are nothing more than congregations like sand in the cracks of shoe prints to the giantesses. The government's lottery system has begun its cruel operation, with countless families waiting for the results in terror. The atmosphere in the streets is filled with despair, and everyone knows exactly what selected fate means. As the leader of a vassal state, you must respond to stabilize (or exploit) this boiling public sentiment.

original: 尽管心如刀割，但反抗意味着整个文明可能被一只巨足轻易抹去。出动治安部队镇压任何形式的反抗，确保『货物』能准时、足量地送达。并向它们保证，它们的牺牲将被铭记(尽管无人会记得)\n§Y交出[event_target:gts_bruh_get_subject_pop_usage_1_planet.GetName]10%的人口§!
translation: Though it's heartbreaking, resistance means the entire civilization could be easily wiped out by a single giant foot. Deploy security forces to suppress any form of resistance, ensuring the 'cargo' is delivered on time and in full. Assure them their sacrifice will be remembered (though none will remember).\n§YHand over 10% of the population of [event_target:gts_bruh_get_subject_pop_usage_1_planet.GetName]§!

original: 既然无法反抗，不如极尽谄媚之能事。我们不仅足额上交，还额外交出双倍的资源，并请求巨娘在享用贡品时，偶尔能想起我们的忠诚，以期换取未来配额可能的减少或微不足道的赏赐\n§Y交出[event_target:gts_bruh_get_subject_pop_usage_1_planet.GetName]25%的人口§!\n§Y下次徵收改为30年後§!
translation: Since we cannot resist, it is better to exert every effort to flatter. We will not only meet the quota but also offer double the resources in addition, requesting that the giantesses occasionally remember our loyalty when enjoying the tribute, in hopes of potential future quota reductions or meager rewards.\n§YHand over 25% of the population of [event_target:gts_bruh_get_subject_pop_usage_1_planet.GetName]§!\n§YNext requisition changed to 30 years later§!

original:
会议室内的灯光显得格外昏暗,厚重的金属门已经紧紧关闭,外面的警卫也被遣散到走廊尽头.
椭圆形的会议桌旁坐着帝国最有权势的几个人,§H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!、星区总督、首相,还有几位平时连面都很难见到的政府高层.
每个人的脸上都写满了不安和困惑.
桌子的一端,一个看起来普通的少女投影静静地坐在那里.
她看起来十分年轻,穿着简单的白色连衣裙,双手安静地叠放在膝盖上.
如果不知道真相,任何人都会以为这只是一个无害的孩子.
但在座的每个人都清楚,眼前这个投影背後的真实存在正漂浮在星球轨道外的太空中,她的真正体型足以用手指握住整颗星球.
§Y"各位,感谢大家抽出宝贵时间参加这次...特殊会议."§!首相清了清嗓子,声音有些颤抖.
他手中的文件夹边缘已经被汗水浸湿.
§Y"今天讨论的议题是关於...关於星球改造授权法案."§!少女投影轻松地靠在椅背上,双腿轻轻晃动着,就像个在课堂上感到无聊的学生.
§M"其实这件事没什麽大不了的啦."§!她的声音甜美而漫不经心.
§M"你们想想看,我帮你们改造那些星球,其实对大家都有好处呢."§!她数着手指,语气就像在讨论明天的天气.
§M"比如说,那些产出不高的农业星球,我可以把它们变成超级肥沃的土地."
"还有那些矿产枯竭的星球,经过我的...处理...之後,保证会有源源不断的新资源."
§!§M"而且啊."§!她歪了歪头,笑得很天真.
§M"人口过剩的问题也能一并解决掉,多省心呢!"§!星区总督的脸色变得苍白如纸,双手紧握成拳.
§R"省心?你知道你在说什麽吗?"§!他猛地站起身来,椅子发出刺耳的摩擦声.
§R"我看过那些报告!我亲眼见过那些被你"改造"过的星球!"§!他的声音变得颤抖而愤怒.
§R"原本的蓝色海洋变成了恶心的爱液!大气层充满了令人窒息的气味!山脉被夷为平地,取而代之的是巨大的...的..."§!
他停顿了一下,努力控制着自己的情绪.§R"那根本不是什麽改造!那是彻底的毁灭!"§!
少女投影眨了眨眼睛,表情依然轻松,§M"哎呀,星区总督先生说话真夸张呢.那些星球现在过得很好啊,产出比以前高多了."
§!她用手支着下巴,§M"而且居民们也很适应新环境的.那些还活着的人都说很幸福呢."§!
§R"还活着的人?"§!星区总督的声音近乎嘶吼.
§R"你知道有多少人在那些"改造"中死去吗?数十亿的生命!他们被你当作玩具一样随意处置!"§!他转向其他人,眼中满含绝望.
§R"你们都看到过那些影像资料!整座城市被碾成粉末,文明的痕迹在几个小时内就彻底消失!那些幸存者被迫生活在...在那种环境下,根本不是人类该有的生活!"§!
会议室内陷入了死一般的沉寂.所有人都低着头,没有人敢接话,没有人敢与星区总督的目光对视.
他们都知道星区总督说的是事实,但同时也都明白反对的後果.
少女投影似乎完全没有被星区总督的话影响,她还是那副轻松的样子.
§M"星区总督先生也很容易激动呢.不过话说回来..."§!
她用一种讨论购物清单的语气说道,§M"我这次想要改造的那几颗星球,确实很有潜力."
"想想看,经过我的处理之後,你们就能获得那麽多新资源,还能解决掉一些...不太听话的总督问题."
"一举两得呢!"§!
§H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!缓缓抬起头,声音沙哑.
§H"§M[event_target:gts_bruh_ap_gts_planet_event_leader.GetName]§!,我必须说,这个决定会违背我们帝国的基本原则..."§!
§M"原则?"§!少女投影歪着头,天真地问道,§M"什麽原则比实际利益更重要呢?而且啊..."§!
她的语气变得更加随意,§M"不管你们同不同意,我都会去做的."
"通过法律程序的话,大家面子上都好看一些嘛."§!她站起身来,双手背在身後,就像个在花园里散步的少女.
§M"如果没有这个授权书,我就只能...怎麽说呢,比较直接地行动了."
"到时候可就没有什麽法律保护了呢."§!
星区总督绝望地看向其他人,但每个人都避开了他的目光.
首相、政府高层们都紧盯着桌面,§H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!则闭上了眼睛,似乎在进行某种内心的挣扎.
§R"你们就这样看着吗?"§!星区总督的声音变得哽咽,§R"就这样眼睁睁地看着无数生命被当作消遣品?"§!没有人回答他.
少女投影轻快地拍了拍手,§M"那麽,既然大家都没有异议,我们就开始签字吧!§H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!,您的签名就代表整个帝国的意志呢."
"多麽重要的历史时刻啊!"§!
首相颤抖着打开文件夹,取出那份授权书.纸张在他手中微微颤动.
一个接一个,在座的每个人都在授权书上签下了自己的名字.
每一笔都沉重如山.
星区总督最後一个签字,他的手颤抖得几乎握不住笔.
当最後一个签名完成时,少女投影开心地转了个圈,§M"太棒了!那麽我就先去准备啦!"
"[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle],我会很快联系您讨论具体时间的."§!
投影开始变淡,她挥了挥手,§M"再见啦,各位!希望很快就能看到成果呢!"§!
投影消失,会议室内只剩下压抑的喘息声.
translation:
The lights in the conference room were dim, the heavy metal doors firmly shut, and the exterior guards dismissed to the far end of the corridor.
Around the oval conference table sat the empire's most powerful figures: §H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, the Sector Governor, the Prime Minister, and several senior officials rarely seen in public.
Unease and confusion were etched upon every face.
At one end of the table, the projection of an ordinary-looking young girl sat quietly.
She looked very young, dressed in a simple white dress, hands folded neatly in her lap.
Anyone unaware of the truth would assume she was merely a harmless child.
Yet everyone present knew full well that the true entity behind this projection was floating out in space beyond the planet's orbit, her actual size large enough to cup the entire world in her palm.
§Y"Everyone, thank you for taking the time to attend this... special meeting."§! The Prime Minister cleared his throat, his voice trembling slightly.
The edges of the folder in his hands were already soaked with sweat.
§Y"Today's topic of discussion concerns... concerns the Planetary Modification Authorization Act."§! The girl's projection leaned back casually against her chair, swinging her legs lightly like a student bored in class.
§M"It's really no big deal, honestly."§! Her voice was sweet and nonchalant.
§M"Think about it. Me modifying those planets for you is actually beneficial for everyone."§! She counted on her fingers, tone as casual as discussing tomorrow's weather.
§M"For example, those low-yield agricultural planets—I could turn them into super-fertile lands.
And those planets with depleted mineral reserves, after my... processing... I guarantee there will be an endless supply of fresh resources."
§!§M"Besides,"§! She tilted her head, smiling with utter innocence.
§M"The overpopulation problem gets solved all at once too. So convenient!"§! The Sector Governor's face turned as pale as paper, his hands balling into tight fists.
§R"Convenient? Do you even know what you're saying?"§! He bolted upright, his chair screeching against the floor.
§R"I've read those reports! I've seen the planets you've "modified" with my own eyes!"§! His voice shook with fury.
§R"The pristine blue oceans turned into sickening love fluid! The atmosphere choked with suffocating stench! Mountains flattened to the ground, replaced by enormous... of..."§!
He paused, struggling to master his emotions. §R"That isn't modification at all! That is utter annihilation!"§!
The girl's projection blinked, her expression remaining carefree. §M"Oh my, Governor, you exaggerate so much. Those planets are doing wonderful right now; their output is way higher than before."
§! She rested her chin in her hands. §M"And the residents have adapted to their new environment nicely. The ones still alive all say they're very happy."§!
§R"The ones still alive?"§! The Sector Governor's voice was practically a shriek.
§R"Do you know how many died during those "modifications"? Billions of lives! You disposed of them at your whim like mere playthings!"§! He turned to the others, his eyes filled with despair.
§R"You've all seen the footage! Entire cities ground to dust, traces of civilization wiped out in hours! Those survivors forced to live in... under those conditions, that's no life fit for anyone!"§!
A deathly hush fell over the room. Everyone kept their heads down; no one dared respond, nor meet the Sector Governor's gaze.
They knew he spoke the truth, but they also understood the consequences of defiance.
The girl's projection seemed entirely unfazed by the Governor's words, her relaxed demeanour unchanged.
§M"You really get worked up easily, Governor. But having said that..."§!
She continued in the tone of someone reviewing a grocery list: §M"Those planets I want to modify this time have tremendous potential.
Just think, after my treatment, you'll gain all those new resources, and you can also take care of a few... unruly governors.
Two birds with one stone!"§!
§H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§! slowly looked up, voice raspy.
§H"§M[event_target:gts_bruh_ap_gts_planet_event_leader.GetName]§!, I must say, this decision contradicts our empire's fundamental principles..."§!
§M"Principles?"§! The girl tilted her head, asking innocently, §M"What principle matters more than real benefits? And besides..."§!
Her tone grew even more casual: §M"Whether you agree or not, I'm going to do it anyway.
Going through legal procedures just makes everyone look a little better."§! She stood up, clasping her hands behind her back, strolling like a young girl in a garden.
§M"Without this authorization, I'd have to... how should I put it, act a bit more directly.
There won't be any legal protection then, will there?"§!
The Sector Governor looked desperately around, but everyone avoided his gaze.
The Prime Minister and senior officials stared fixedly at the tabletop, while §H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§! closed their eyes, seemingly caught in an internal struggle.
§R"Are you all just going to watch?"§! The Governor's voice choked. §R"Just stand by and watch countless lives be treated as playthings?"§! No one answered.
The girl's projection clapped her hands cheerfully. §M"Well, since nobody has any objections, let's start signing! §H[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle]§!, your signature represents the will of the entire empire.
What a historic moment!"§!
Trembling, the Prime Minister opened his folder and took out the authorization document. The paper quivered in his hands.
One by one, everyone present signed their names.
Every stroke felt as heavy as a mountain.
The Sector Governor was the last to sign, his hand shaking so violently he could barely hold the pen.
As the final signature was finished, the girl's projection twirled with delight. §M"Wonderful! I'll go get things ready then!
[ruler.GetRegnalName][Root.GetRulerTitle], I'll contact you soon to discuss the specific timing."§!
The projection began to fade. She waved. §M"Goodbye, everyone! Hope to see the results very soon!"§!
The projection vanished, leaving only stifled gasps echoing in the conference room.

original: 根据本公司与微观客户签署的§Y《天体级生物安全保障协定》§!，每隔十年，公司将启动资产回收程序进行保费结算。监於双方在体型与经济体系上的维度差异，常规货币已失去流通意义，因此协议规定以该文明的「生物人口」作为唯一认可的等价交换物。董事会可需根据当前的库存需求与外交战略，调整本周期的保费徵收费率。此项决策将直接决定流入公司加工厂与宠物市场的货源数量，同时也会对客户文明的社会结构造成不同程度的物理性削减，进而影响其对公司的外交态度。\n\n§Y(只会向人口超过5000的星球收费)§!
translation: According to the §Y'Celestial-level Bio-Security Guarantee Agreement'§! signed between this Company and our micro-clients, every ten years, the Company will initiate asset recovery procedures for insurance premium settlement. Given the dimensional differences between the two parties in terms of size and economic systems, conventional currency has lost its significance for circulation; therefore, the agreement stipulates 'biological population' as the only recognized equivalent for exchange. The board of directors may adjust this cycle's premium collection rate based on current inventory needs and diplomatic strategies. This decision will directly determine the volume of 'goods' flowing into our processing plants and pet markets, while also causing varying degrees of physical reduction to the client civilizations' social structure, thereby affecting their diplomatic attitude toward the Company. \n\n§Y(Only charges planets with a population over 5000)§!

original: 执行最高规格的保费方案。获准对客户星球启动广域地表刮削作业，强制徵收该星球总人口的5%。这一比例对於任何微观文明而言皆属灾难性的社会创伤，将导致其劳动力断层与经济崩溃，并极大降低客户的外交态度。然而，这将为公司带来极其丰厚的「小人资源」，满足内部对微缩生物的高涨需求。
translation: Executes the highest-spec premium plan. Authorized to initiate wide-area surface scraping operations on the client planet, forcibly requisitioning 5% of the total population. This ratio is a catastrophic social trauma for any micro-civilization, leading to labor gaps and economic collapse, and significantly lowering the client's diplomatic stance. However, it will bring极其 rich 'tiny resources' to the company, satisfying internal surging demand for micro-organisms.

original: 执行标准偏高的保费方案，将保险费率上调至4%\n这一比例虽略低於极限压榨，但对於微观文明而言，短时间内失去大量人口仍是沉重的负担。预期客户社会内部会产生强烈的恐慌与不满情绪，外交评估报告指出，长期维持此费率将持续侵蚀双方信任基础。虽然能确保大量资源流入，但需警惕潜在的违约行为，建议加强对该星球的武力威慑以确保合约履行。
translation: Executes a high-standard premium plan, raising the insurance rate to 4%.\nWhile this ratio is slightly lower than extreme exploitation, losing a large population in a short time is still a heavy burden for micro-civilizations. Strong panic and dissatisfaction are expected within the client's society. Diplomatic assessment reports indicate that maintaining this rate long-term will continue to erode the foundation of trust. Although it ensures a large influx of resources, one must be wary of potential defaults; strengthening military deterrence over the planet is recommended to ensure contract fulfillment.

original: 维持标准的保费方案，将保险费率设定为2%\n这是一个精算後的折衷商业选择，既能维持公司的基础资源运作与巨娘员工的日常消耗需求，又不至於在短时间内彻底破坏客户的社会再生产能力。客户对此虽然怀有恐惧，但在绝对体型威慑下尚能维持基本的服从与运作。
translation: Maintains a standard premium plan, setting the insurance rate to 2%.\nThis is an actuarially compromised commercial choice that maintains the company's basic resource operations and the daily consumption needs of giantess employees without thoroughly destroying the client's social reproduction capabilities in a short time. While the client harbors fear, they can still maintain basic obedience and operation under absolute size deterrence.

original: 采取象徵性的保费方案，仅徵收1%的人口作为象徵性保费。对於坐拥庞大人口基数的微观文明而言，这一损失比例极低，甚至低於其自身因自然灾害或疾病造成的自然伤亡率。这种相对宽松的策略极大纾解了客户的生存压力与恐慌感，有助於维持较高的信任度与良好的外交态度。虽然公司本周期获得的实体生物资源减少，但稳定的客户关系有利於长期的渗透与其他高附加值服务的推广，符合长远利益最大化模型。
translation: Adopts a symbolic premium plan, requisitioning only 1% of the population as a symbolic fee. For micro-civilizations with a large population base, this loss ratio is extremely low, even lower than their own natural casualty rates from natural disasters or diseases. This relatively relaxed strategy significantly eases the client's survival pressure and panic, helping to maintain high trust and a good diplomatic stance. Although the company receives fewer physical biological resources this cycle, stable client relationships are conducive to long-term penetration and the promotion of other high-value-added services, fitting the long-term profit maximization model.

original: 暂停本周期的实物保费徵收。公司将以「市场推广」、「特别恩典」或「人道主义关怀」的名义，全额豁免该星球的保费。这一反常的仁慈举动将极大程度地消除其对巨娘企业的敌意。虽然本周期公司将无法从该客户处获得任何小人资源，且需自行承担运营成本，但这将最大限度地提升外交态度。\n\n§Y(不会触发保费缴交事件)§!
translation: Suspends physical premium requisition for this cycle. The company will fully waive the planet's premium under the name of "Marketing Promotion," "Special Grace," or "Humanitarian Care." This unusual act of benevolence will greatly eliminate hostility towards the giantess enterprise. Although the company will not obtain any tiny resources from this client this cycle and must bear operating costs itself, it will maximize diplomatic attitude.\n\n§Y(Will not trigger premium payment event)§!

original: 刚刚从海军学校毕业的舰娘们所穿的学校制服，从里到外都透着少女的芬芳。
translation: The school uniform worn by Shipgirls who have just graduated from naval academy, exuding the fragrance of youth from head to toe.

original: 舰娘们在庆功晚宴上所穿的礼服，在胸前挂着（或粘着）代表其战功的敌舰残骸。
translation: The dress uniform worn by Shipgirls at victory banquets, with enemy ship wreckage representing their achievements hanging (or stuck) on their chests.

original: 舰娘们在与她们心仪之人誓约时所穿的婚纱，体型和种族的差距不是阻拦爱情的理由，在这一刻她们与普通的少女无异。
translation: The wedding dress worn by Shipgirls when vowing with their beloved. Differences in size and species are not reasons to stop love; in this moment, they are no different from ordinary maidens.

original: 大部分舰娘所选择的最为经典的内裤类型，在出击时舰娘们常常会准备多条以在战斗结束后及时更换变脏或破损的胖次。
translation: The most classic type of underwear chosen by most Shipgirls. When sortieing, they often prepare multiple pairs to replace soiled or damaged panties after battle.

original: 一些害羞或重视礼节的舰娘们会准备安全裤替代胖次以避免在海战中走光（虽然理论上小人的舰船可以钻进她们身体的任何地方就是了）。
translation: Some shy or etiquette-conscious Shipgirls will prepare safety shorts instead of panties to avoid revealing too much during naval battles (although in theory, tiny people's ships can enter anywhere in their bodies).

original: 一些欲望旺盛或心大的舰娘会选择更加激进的方案，比如蕾丝胖次，传说会有舰娘会把自己俘获的敌舰和船员塞进胖次里寻求刺激。
translation: Some Shipgirls with high desires or bold personalities choose more radical options, such as lace panties. Legend has it that some Shipgirls stuff captured enemy ships and crew into their panties for thrills.

original:
在[event_target:skadi_sit_planet.GetName]上，数以亿计的帝国公民共同见证了这一历史性时刻。现场直播画面中，斯卡蒂那数万公里高的庞大身躯正缓缓从行星表面站起。

§B...博士...别担心，我会很小心的...§!

少女低沉的声音如滚雷般在大气中回荡。她赤足踩在殖民星球上，雪白的长发披散在肩头，泳装紧紧贴着稍稍湿润的皮肤。仅仅只是双腿微微弯曲准备起身的动作，就让脚下的地壳发出低沉的轰隆隆震颤，大片山脉在她脚趾缝隙间崩塌。斯卡蒂红瞳微微眯起，表情认真而专注，拥有大陆体型的她正竭力控制着每一丝力量。她先是慢慢抬起一只脚掌。那只脚掌长度超过两万公里，足底还残留着被压成平地的城市痕迹。无数小人在她脚底的纹路中惊恐地抬头，只看到一片粉嫩却遮天蔽日的肉色天空缓缓远离。斯卡蒂小心地把脚抬起到星球之外的太空中，另一只脚也随之抬起。整个殖民星球在她起身的过程中剧烈摇晃，却奇迹般地没有彻底崩解。脱离行星引力后，斯卡蒂的身体开始主动巨大化。

§B呼...就快到了...§!

随着一声轻轻的吐息，她的身躯以肉眼可见的速度成长。雪白的肌肤在星光下泛着水润的光泽，丰满的胸部、纤细有力的腰肢，以及修长健美的双腿迅速在[event_target:skadi_sit_planet.system.GetName]中展开。曾经被她一屁股坐塌的[event_target:skadi_sit_planet.GetName]，此刻在她脚边只剩下一颗小小的蓝色弹珠。斯卡蒂在星系中轻轻舒展身体，一只手随意抬起到胸前，另一只手则撑在腰侧。她微微弓起背脊，仅仅是呼吸一次，胸前的起伏就掀起星球级的强大气流。少女低头俯视着脚边渺小的帝国舰队与星球，红瞳中带着一丝满足与温柔。

帝国舰队指挥官们望着那几乎填满整个视野的巨大少女身影，既敬畏又振奋。斯卡蒂的存在本身，便为帝国海军提供了前所未有的战力。

§B这样...应该够用了吧？博士，我现在可以正式帮到你们的海军了吧。只要你需要，我可以变得更大...§!\
translation:
On [event_target:skadi_sit_planet.GetName], hundreds of millions of imperial citizens witnessed this historic moment together. In the live broadcast feeds, Skadi's immense form, tens of thousands of kilometers tall, was slowly rising from the surface of the planet.

§B...Doctor... don't worry, I'll be very careful...§!

The girl's low voice echoed through the atmosphere like rolling thunder. She stood barefoot upon the colony world, her long snow-white hair cascading over her shoulders, her swimsuit clinging tightly to her slightly damp skin. The mere motion of slightly bending her legs in preparation to stand caused the planetary crust beneath her to rumble with deep tremors, vast mountain ranges collapsing between the crevices of her toes. Skadi narrowed her crimson eyes slightly, her expression earnest and focused; possessing the stature of an entire continent, she was doing her utmost to rein in every ounce of her strength. First, she slowly lifted one foot. That foot alone stretched over twenty thousand kilometers long, the sole still bearing the impressions of flattened cities. Countless Tinies looked up in terror from the tread-lines of her sole, only to see a soft-pink, sky-obscuring expanse of flesh slowly drifting away. Skadi carefully lifted her foot outward into the vacuum of space, followed by the other. The entire colony world shook violently as she stood up, yet miraculously avoided total collapse. Once freed from planetary gravity, Skadi's body began to actively enlarge.

§BWhew... almost there...§!

With a gentle exhale, her body grew at a speed visible to the naked eye. Her snow-white skin shimmered with a moist luster under the starlight, while her voluptuous bosom, slender yet powerful waist, and long, toned legs rapidly expanded across [event_target:skadi_sit_planet.system.GetName]. The world of [event_target:skadi_sit_planet.GetName], once nearly crushed beneath her backside, was now reduced to a tiny blue marble by her feet. Skadi gently stretched in the star system, casually raising one hand before her chest while resting the other against her hip. She arched her back slightly; with just a single breath, the rise and fall of her chest stirred planet-scale gale-force currents. Gazing down at the minuscule imperial fleet and planets around her feet, a hint of satisfaction and tenderness appeared in the girl's crimson eyes.

Imperial fleet commanders gazed upon the colossal maiden's silhouette that filled nearly their entire field of vision, filled with both awe and exhilaration. Skadi's sheer existence granted the Imperial Navy unprecedented firepower.

§BThis... should be enough, right? Doctor, now I can officially assist your navy. As long as you need me to, I can become even bigger...§!

The moment you press the claim button, Qhai appears out of thin air in front of you without warning. The demon maiden, slightly shorter than you, hops forward with brisk, light steps and stops right before you. Her exquisite beauty and lively bounce leave you momentarily entranced.
§r"*Ahem*, for the sake of ceremony, I'll deliver your first trophy in person!"§!
Qhai giggles playfully as a gleaming golden trophy materializes between her hands. Its pinnacle is crafted in the shape of a celestial body encircled by a blue planetary ring, shimmering brilliantly beneath the lights with an enchanting aura.
Holding the trophy up to you, the maiden casts aside her playful smile and adopts a rare expression of solemn dignity. You instinctively straighten your posture and accept the trophy firmly with both hands.

translation: As our colonization on §Y[Root.GetName]§! has gradually stabilized, our settlers have turned their attention back toward that troublesome pack of giant beast-girls. Exhausted colonists constantly lodge complaints with the colonial administration regarding the beast-girls' antics, yet unable to restrain them due to their immense size and inhuman strength, they demand immediate solutions from colonial officials. Given the newly founded colony's scarce resources, the local administration was powerless to resolve the crisis, ultimately bringing this string of incidents caused by giant beast-girls before our Parliament.\n\nOur scientists propose establishing local reservations to minimize the damage these colossal creatures cause to the colony, while using them as living subjects to study giantess physiology. Meanwhile, military officials insist that an uncontrollable, rambunctious giant beast is the ultimate war weapon, having already begun studying the feasibility of mounting explosive reactive armor on them. In the corner of the assembly, members of a newly emergent mystical faction plead passionately: 'If they are beasts, they can be tamed! We should bestow wisdom upon these savage creatures so they may one day become proud citizens of our great nation.'

original: 蕾恩娜留下的巨型足印
这个覆盖了整片大陆的巨型足印是蕾恩娜留下来的。曾经繁华的城市群、连绵的山脉、广袤的平原，都在她轻描淡写的一踩之下化为乌有。足印深处仍在涌动的岩浆让这颗星球不再适合居住，地壳的破碎也让这颗曾经美丽的星球变得不再稳定。然而讽刺的是，这场灾难反而让星球的矿物资源更易开采——仿佛是她留下的某种"恩赐"。
translation: This colossal footprint covering an entire continent was left behind by Rainna. Once-bustling city clusters, sprawling mountain ranges, and vast plains were all wiped out under her nonchalant step. Molten magma still churning in the depths of the print makes this planet no longer fit for habitation, and the shattered crust renders this formerly beautiful world unstable. Ironically, this catastrophe has instead made the planet's mineral resources easier to extract—as if it were some kind of "boon" she left behind.

original: 蕾恩娜碾磨过的巨型足印
这不仅仅是一个足印。蕾恩娜在踩下之后，还饶有兴致地用足底反复碾磨了几下，将破坏的范围扩大了数倍。原本清晰的足印轮廓被摩擦得模糊不清，取而代之的是一大片被彻底抹平的焦土。城市、山脉、河流，一切的一切都被碾成了紧贴地表的一层薄薄的痕迹，混杂在翻涌的岩浆与碎裂的地壳之间。这颗星球承受的，是远比一次踩踏更为彻底的蹂躏。
translation: This is more than just a footprint. After stepping down, Rainna playfully ground her sole against the surface multiple times, expanding the scope of destruction several-fold. The once-distinct contour of the footprint was blurred by the friction, replaced by a massive expanse of completely flattened scorched earth. Cities, mountains, rivers—everything was pulverized into a thin smear clinging to the bedrock, mingled between churning magma and shattered crust. What this planet endured was a ravaging far more thorough than a simple stomp.

original: 蕾恩娜留下的巨型足趾印
translation: Colossal Toe Print Left by Rainna

original: 一个巨大的圆坑，覆盖了曾经繁华的城市群以及周围连绵的山脉。至少她没有将整个巨足落下，也许，这也算是她的仁慈。
translation: A massive circular crater covering what was once a bustling metropolitan cluster and the surrounding mountain ranges. At least she did not bring down her entire giant foot—perhaps, in a way, this could be considered her mercy.

original: 蕾恩娜留下的巨型指印
一个巨大的圆坑，将曾经繁华的城市群、周围的山脉都在一瞬间化为一个深不见底的坑。深处仍在涌动的岩浆让这颗星球不再适合居住，这颗曾经美丽的星球也变得不再稳定。然而，这场灾难反而让星球的矿物资源更易开采，也许这就是她降下的"恩泽"。
translation: A colossal crater that instantly reduced bustling cities and surrounding mountains into a bottomless pit. Molten magma still surging in its depths renders this world inhospitable, destabilizing what was once a beautiful planet. Yet, ironically, this disaster made the planet's mineral resources much easier to extract—perhaps this is the "grace" she bestowed upon us.

original: 蕾恩娜的手指留下的峡谷
一个由纯粹的暴力美学挖出的巨型峡谷，巨大到甚至破坏了星球的稳定性。这条峡谷所覆盖的一切名胜古迹、城市群、山脉、甚至海洋已然完全被这平整的巨大峡谷替代。然而，一些深埋于地下的资源意外露出表面，这也许是她的恩赐。
translation: A colossal canyon carved out by sheer violent aesthetics, so gargantuan that it destabilized the entire planet. All historical monuments, urban clusters, mountain ranges, and even oceans once situated here have been completely replaced by this smooth, immense gorge. Yet, certain resources buried deep underground were unexpectedly exposed to the surface—perhaps another of her boons.

original: 一片乳白色的、散发着朦胧热气的巨大湖泊，是蕾恩娜停留时无意间留下的痕迹。湖水弥漫着某种令人陶醉却又难以名状的气息，据说靠近它的生物会不由自主地被吸引，直至沉醉其中、失去意识。这片湖泊的成分至今无法被完全解析，但它确实改变了这颗星球的生态，让周围的一切都笼罩在一层暧昧而危险的氤氲之中。
translation: A massive, milky-white lake radiating a hazy warmth, left behind inadvertently during Rainna's visit. The waters emanate an intoxicating, indescribable scent; it is said that creatures drawing near are irresistibly drawn to it until they swoon and lose consciousness. The exact composition of this lake remains impossible to decipher, but it has profoundly reshaped the planet's ecology, shrouding everything nearby in an ambiguous and perilous vapor.

original: 蕾恩娜心血来潮时降下的一场甘霖。与她惯常的破坏不同，这场雨带来的是纯粹的恩泽——清澈的雨水滋润了干涸的土地，抚平了创伤，让荒芜的大地重新焕发生机。作物茁壮成长，河流重新奔涌，整颗星球都因这场雨而变得更加富饶。也许，这就是她偶尔流露出的、罕见的温柔。
translation: A sweet rainfall bestowed on a whim by Rainna. Unlike her usual devastation, this rain brought pure blessings—clear rainwater quenched the parched earth, healed scars, and rejuvenated the barren land with vibrant life. Crops flourished, rivers surged anew, and the entire planet grew richer from this downpour. Perhaps this was a glimpse of her rare, fleeting tenderness.

original: 蕾恩娜碾磨过的超巨型足印
这是一个大到超乎想象的足印，是蕾恩娜以更加庞大的姿态降临时留下的。仅仅一只足底，就覆盖了这颗星球相当大的一部分。而她并不满足于此，还在踩下之后反复碾磨，让破坏的范围进一步扩大。曾经的大陆、海洋、文明的一切痕迹，都在这难以想象的蹂躏中被彻底抹去，只剩下一片广袤无垠的焦土与翻涌的岩浆。这颗星球的地质结构已经濒临崩溃，能够残存至今，本身就是一个奇迹。
translation: This is a footprint vast beyond imagination, left behind when Rainna descended in an even more gigantic form. A single sole alone blanketed a considerable portion of this world. Unsatisfied with merely stepping down, she repeatedly ground her foot against the surface, expanding the realm of destruction still further. Former continents, oceans, and every trace of civilization were utterly obliterated in this unfathomable ravaging, leaving only a boundless expanse of scorched wasteland and churning magma. The planetary crust teeters on the brink of total collapse; that it survives at all is itself a miracle.

original: 昏暗的扭曲空间之内隐约散发着绝望的情绪。麻木、啜泣，悲鸣着、闪耀着。似乎原有什么谜团等待着被解开。
translation: Within the dimly lit, distorted space, faint whispers of despair emanate. Numbness, sobbing, weeping, and flickering. It seems some original mystery awaits unraveling.

original:
“打扰了，我是蕾恩娜。我听说你在找我？

也许你从未听说过我的名字——不过没关系，点击‘是’之后，你很快就会对我印象深刻的。”

这是谁留下的奇怪信息？

点击“是”则会在宇宙中生成蕾恩娜相关内容。
translation:
"Excuse me, I am Rainna. I heard you were looking for me?\n\nPerhaps you have never heard my name before—but no matter, after clicking 'Yes', you will soon have a very deep impression of me."

Who left this strange message?

Clicking "Yes" will spawn Rainna-related content across the universe.

original:
科研团队在黑洞的另一侧探查到了一个神秘的实体。

根据初步观测，她的体型远超任何已知的天体生命，却只是静静地漂浮在黑洞边缘，似乎只是陷入了某种深度的沉眠。好奇的科学家们摩拳擦掌，迫不及待地请求前去唤醒她。

然而，你的内心深处有一种隐隐的不安。也许……先处理完手头的其他事情会更稳妥一些。
translation:
The science team has detected a mysterious entity on the other side of the black hole.

According to preliminary observations, her size far exceeds any known celestial lifeform, yet she drifts silently at the edge of the event horizon, seemingly lost in deep slumber. Eager and curious, our scientists are practically begging for permission to go and awaken her.

Yet deep within, an ominous unease lingers. Perhaps... it would be much safer to attend to other pressing matters first.

original:
不知是何时，黑洞另一侧的那个巨大身影悄然消失了。

观测站的屏幕上只剩下一片平静的虚空，仿佛什么都不曾发生过。科学家们面面相觑，翻遍了所有的观测记录，却找不到任何她离去的痕迹。

也许……这一切只是一场梦？
translation:
At some unknown moment, the gargantuan figure on the other side of the black hole vanished without a trace.

The observatory monitors display only tranquil void, as if nothing had ever existed there. Scientists exchange bewildered glances and comb through every observation log, yet find no trace of her departure whatsoever.

Perhaps... this was all just a dream?

original:
[Planet.GetName]的行星防御系统在深夜突然发出了警报。

值班人员被刺耳的警报声惊醒，冲到监控屏幕前。雷达上，一个庞大的物体正从深空缓缓接近，它的体积超出了系统预设的所有分类参数，以至于计算机一度将其误判为一颗小行星。

但小行星不会主动调整轨道。

随着那个物体越来越近，观测数据变得越来越清晰，也越来越令人不安。防御指挥中心陷入了短暂的沉默，所有人都想起了那个流传已久的名字。
translation:
In the dead of night, [Planet.GetName]'s planetary defense grid suddenly blared an alarm.

Staff on duty were startled awake by the piercing klaxon and rushed to their monitoring stations. On the radar, a colossal object was slowly approaching from deep space. Its sheer volume exceeded every classification parameter programmed into the system, causing the computers to initially misidentify it as an asteroid.

Yet asteroids do not adjust their own trajectories.

As the object drew nearer, sensor telemetry grew sharper—and far more disturbing. The defense command center fell into a stunned silence as everyone remembered that name whispered for eons.

original:
[Planet.GetName]轨道监测站记录到了异常。

一个巨大的阴影正在遮蔽远处的星光，缓慢却坚定地朝这颗星球靠近。它没有发出任何标准的通讯信号，也没有回应任何询问，只是静静地、庞大地存在着，像是一片移动的黑暗。

监测站的负责人调出了历史数据，很快，他的脸色变得凝重起来。

这个接近模式，他们并不陌生。
translation:
The orbital monitoring station over [Planet.GetName] has recorded an anomaly.

A titanic shadow is blotting out the distant starlight, approaching the world with slow, steady inevitability. It transmits no standard communication signals and ignores all hails, simply looming there—vast and silent, like a roaming swath of primordial darkness.

The station commander pulled up historical archival data, and his expression quickly hardened.

This approach vector was all too familiar.

original:
警报响起的时候，[Planet.GetName]的大多数居民还在睡梦之中。

防御系统检测到一个体积异常庞大的物体正在接近大气层，它的规模让所有的拦截预案都失去了意义——没有任何武器系统的设计参数考虑过如此巨大的目标。指挥官盯着屏幕上那个不断放大的轮廓，手指悬在警报按钮上方，却迟迟没有按下。

因为他知道，无论按不按，结果恐怕都不会有什么不同。

那个熟悉的身影，又回来了。
translation:
When the sirens began wailing, most inhabitants of [Planet.GetName] were still fast asleep.

The defense systems detected an entity of staggering proportions entering the upper atmosphere. Its scale made every planetary interception protocol entirely moot—no defense grid had ever been designed with a target this monstrous in mind. The commander stared blankly at the expanding silhouette on the holo-screen, his finger hovering over the general evacuation klaxon, yet never pressing it down.

He knew deep down that pressing it would change nothing.

That familiar figure had returned.

original:
“长官，您得来看看这个。”

[Planet.GetName]防御中心的技术员声音发颤。屏幕上，一个庞大的物体正在穿越外层空间，朝着这颗星球径直而来。它的体积大得不像话，轮廓却意外地……有机。

那不是飞船，不是小行星，也不是任何已知的天体。

指挥官盯着屏幕看了很久，最终缓缓开口，声音里带着一丝难以掩饰的疲惫：

“通知所有人。”

“她来了。”
translation:
"Commander, you need to see this."

The technician at the [Planet.GetName] defense headquarters spoke with a trembling voice. On the screen, a colossal form was cruising through exospheric space, heading straight toward the world. Its dimensions were mind-bogglingly immense, yet its contours were unmistakably... organic.

It was not a starship, nor an asteroid, nor any recognized astronomical body.

The commander stared into the screen for a long while before finally speaking, his voice heavy with weary resignation:

"Alert everyone."

"She is here."

Incoming Signal

"Hello there, I'm 'Tall Rainna'."

The voice on the other end is cheerful and casual, as natural as a neighbor dropping by for a visit.

"I'm a lonely traveler, and I've been walking for so, so long~ May I... have your permission to rest my feet on your planet, and take in your magnificent culture while I'm at it?"

She pauses for a moment.

"Don't worry, nothing bad will happen..."

original:
首次捕捉到这个反常现象的是我们的科研穿的观测数据，那时，没人把它当回事。远方群星璀璨的夜空中，只是一小片区域略显暗淡，遮蔽了几颗原本清晰可见的恒星。[this.GetName]的天文台很快确认了这一观测结果，但大多数研究人员只是将其归类为一次普通的天文异常现象。

然而，短短数日之间，情况急转直下。那片异常的阴影以惊人的速度扩张，吞噬了越来越多的星光。科学家了解到，这是一个正在向[this.GetName]疾驰而来的神秘天体，它的轨迹飘忽不定，既不符合已知天体的运动规律，也不像是任何文明制造的航行器。

[this.GetName]的科学院紧急召开了专题研讨会。当首席科学家[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]走出会议厅时，焦虑与恐惧似乎能将[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim]压倒。几十年的研究生涯中，[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim]从未见过如此诡异的现象。就在这时，天空骤然变色，翻涌的云层被一股莫名的力量撕裂，狂风呼啸着掠过地面，卷起落叶和碎屑，像是某种不祥的预兆。

那个庞大的存在终于显露出真容——一张与天际融为一体的巨脸。她的双眸如同两汪深邃的湖水，每一次眨动都伴随着震耳欲聋的雷鸣，掀起足以摧毁一切的飓风。[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]的长发在狂风中狂舞，她想要喊些什么，却被呼啸的风声淹没。

 “不，等一下！”

话音未落，一根被风暴掀起的粗壮树枝划破长空，重重砸在[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]身上。她的身体重重摔在台阶上，还未及爬起，就被狂暴的气流卷入高空……

与此同时，信号接入。
translation:
The anomaly was first captured by observation data from our science ship, though at the time, no one took it seriously. In the starry night sky far away, only a tiny patch appeared slightly dim, obscuring a few stars that had previously been clearly visible. Observatories on [this.GetName] quickly confirmed the finding, yet most researchers simply classified it as an ordinary astronomical anomaly.

However, within just a few days, the situation took a sharp turn for the worse. That anomalous shadow expanded at an astonishing speed, swallowing more and more starlight. Scientists soon realized that a mysterious celestial entity was hurtling toward [this.GetName]—its trajectory erratic and unpredictable, adhering neither to the laws of known celestial bodies nor resembling any vessel built by civilization.

The Academy of Sciences on [this.GetName] urgently convened an extraordinary seminar. When Chief Scientist [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName] stepped out of the conference hall, anxiety and dread threatened to overwhelm [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim]. In decades of research, [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim] had never witnessed such a bizarre phenomenon. Just then, the sky suddenly changed color. Billowing clouds were torn apart by an inexplicable force, and howling gales swept across the ground, kicking up fallen leaves and debris like an ominous harbinger.

The colossal presence finally unveiled its true form—a gigantic face seamlessly blending into the horizon. Her eyes were like two deep lakes, and every blink was accompanied by deafening thunder, whipping up hurricanes potent enough to obliterate everything. [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]'s long hair whipped wildly in the tempest; she tried to shout something, but her words were drowned out by the roaring wind.

"No, wait!"

Before the words could fully leave her lips, a thick tree limb hoisted by the storm tore through the air and struck [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName] with brutal force. Her body crashed hard onto the steps, and before she could even scramble to her feet, the violent gale swept her high into the air...

Simultaneously, a signal connects.

original:
最初，那只是夜空中一个微不足道的异常——仅仅是群星璀璨间的一个芝麻大小的暗斑。随后，这个斑点悄然扩大，吞噬了天际角落的几颗星辰。起初，这种变化细微得近乎难以觉察，仿佛只是普通的天文现象。然而短短数日之间，那抹黑暗却如同墨滴入清水，迅速蔓延开来，最终化作一片巨大的黑幕，吞没了大片星河，只留下一片死寂的漆黑。

第二天，紧急会议在[this.GetName]召开，紧张与不安笼罩于在每一个人，那是令人战栗的对未知的恐惧，仿佛下一刻，那吞噬星光的黑暗就会将他们的灵魂也一并吞没。

它已经被确认是一种从未见过的巨大的实体。既不是流星、也不是飞船，它神秘地悄然逼近[this.GetName]，十分迅速，不定的轨迹让在座的每一位学者与科研人员都不敢妄下定论。但是每一个人都十分肯定的是——这个存在，已经离我们太近了。

当首席科学家[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]在会后接受采访的时候，每一个人都看到了那被大气笼罩的巨大的朦胧面孔，那张清秀的面部覆盖了几乎整个天空。伴随着突然的狂风与剧烈的震动，她离我们越来越近。深蓝色的眼瞳就像是湖水一般与天空融为一体，每眨一下都会带来湍急的气流与剧烈的震颤，轻易地折断枝干、卷起物品、撕裂云彩，脚下剧烈的震动甚至让房屋产生了一道道蛛网般蔓延的深邃裂隙。伴随着一声震耳欲聋的轰鸣，坚硬的地面裂开一道深不见底的裂缝狂暴的气流毫不留情地将[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim]推向深渊……

与此同时，信号接入。
translation:
At first, it was merely an insignificant anomaly in the night sky—just a sesame-sized dark speck amidst a brilliant sea of stars. Soon, this speck quietly expanded, devouring several stars at the corner of the horizon. Initially, the change was so subtle as to be almost undetectable, resembling nothing more than an ordinary astronomical phenomenon. Yet in just a few days, that patch of darkness spread swiftly like ink in clear water, ultimately becoming a massive black veil that swallowed vast swathes of the galaxy, leaving behind only a dead, pitch-black void.

The next day, an emergency meeting was convened on [this.GetName]. Tension and unease gripped everyone present—a trembling terror of the unknown, as if at any moment, the darkness that swallowed the stars would consume their souls as well.

It was confirmed to be a colossal entity unlike anything ever seen before. Neither meteor nor starship, it crept silently toward [this.GetName] with astounding speed. Its erratic trajectory prevented any scholar or researcher in attendance from drawing hasty conclusions. But there was one thing everyone knew with absolute certainty—this entity was already far too close to us.

While Chief Scientist [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName] was being interviewed after the meeting, everyone looked up to see a colossal, hazy face shrouded in the atmosphere; those delicate facial features spanned almost the entire sky. Accompanied by sudden howling winds and violent tremors, she drew ever closer. Her deep blue pupils blended seamlessly with the sky like tranquil lakes, yet every blink stirred torrential currents and fierce vibrations, snapping branches, tossing objects, and tearing clouds to shreds. The violent rumbling beneath their feet cracked the ground, web-like fissures creeping across walls and pavement. With a deafening roar, the solid ground split open into a bottomless chasm, and the raging tempest mercilessly plunged [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim] into the abyss...

Simultaneously, a signal connects.

original:
宛如墨滴浸染宣纸，又似星火坠入深秋枯叶。几日前，观测图像角落里的那个微小黑点原本不值一提，只被当作普通的观测异常。然而短短数日之间，它就如同贪婪的墨渍般扩张蔓延，吞噬着越来越多璀璨的星光，犹如无形的烈火，在寂静的宇宙画布上肆意燃烧。

[this.GetName]的研究团队通过精密观测发现，这是一个正在接近我们的神秘天体。它的行迹诡秘难测，仿佛刻意避开所有探测手段，却又笔直地朝我们的星球疾驰而来。这个神秘的天体的运动轨迹十分奇特，它既不属于任何小行星或者流星，也不属于任何已知的飞行器。一场灾祸正在酝酿。
第二天，[this.GetName]实验中心陷入一片紧张氛围。紧急会议室内，科研人员们争分夺秒地讨论着各种可能性和应对方案。似乎在认为这是一个可以解决的问题。

在随后的新闻发布会上，首席科学家[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]的表情异常凝重。[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHis]小心翼翼地斟酌着每一个字句，试图编织一张由谎言构筑的安全网，生怕真相的锋芒会通过媒体刺痛每个人脆弱的神经。然而，命运早已悄然降临。

最初只是一阵突如其来的强风，撕碎了空中的云层。紧接着，在那湛蓝的天际线上，浮现出一对如深邃湖泊般的巨大瞳孔。清秀的面庞随之显现，覆盖了大半个天穹。她的每一次眨眼都仿佛是两颗巨星的碰撞，震耳欲聋的巨响中迸发出的能量掀起狂暴飓风，让大地剧烈颤抖，轻易地掀翻任何哪怕有一点脆弱的物品……没错，就是那辆停在[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]的豪华车。被气流轻轻托起。在这场灾难面前，这精心打造的钢铁造物不过是一片羽毛。当它重重砸下时，[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]甚至来不及发出一声惊呼……

与此同时，信号接入。
translation:
Like ink soaking into rice paper, or a spark landing upon dry autumn leaves. A few days ago, the tiny black dot in the corner of the observation imagery was hardly worth mentioning, written off as nothing more than a routine imaging artifact. Yet in mere days, it expanded and spread like a voracious ink stain, devouring more and more brilliant starlight—an invisible blaze burning across the quiet canvas of the cosmos.

Through meticulous observation, the research team on [this.GetName] discovered that this was a mysterious celestial body approaching us. Its movements were baffling and evasive, as if deliberately avoiding detection, yet hurtling straight toward our world. The trajectory of this mysterious entity was extraordinary—it was neither asteroid nor meteor, nor did it match any known craft. A disaster was brewing.
The following day, the research center on [this.GetName] was plunged into tense apprehension. Inside the emergency conference room, researchers raced against time to debate every conceivable scenario and contingency, clinging to the belief that this was still a solvable crisis.

At the ensuing press briefing, Chief Scientist [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]'s expression was exceptionally grim. [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHis] words were weighed with utmost care, attempting to spin a safety net of comforting half-truths for fear that the sharp edge of reality would shatter the public's fragile nerves. Yet destiny had already arrived.

It began as a sudden, violent gale tearing through the clouds above. Immediately thereafter, on the azure horizon, a pair of colossal pupils resembling deep lakes materialized. A delicate, serene face followed, covering more than half the firmament. Every time she blinked felt like the collision of two giant stars; the energy unleashed in deafening thunder generated raging hurricanes that rattled the earth, effortlessly flipping anything remotely fragile... including the luxury car belonging to [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName], which was lifted into the air like a feather by the updraft. Before this calamity, the meticulously engineered steel machine was nothing more than a plaything. When it crashed down with crushing force, [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName] did not even have time to cry out...

Simultaneously, a signal connects.

original:
在[this.GetName]的观测站，每一张流传到网络上的星空照片都是一幅璀璨的艺术品。无数闪烁的恒星编织成银河的锦缎，装点着漆黑的夜空。
直到有一天，一位细心的用户花费了数个小时找到了一个异常的地方，在照片的边角，一颗曾经明亮的恒星不知何时已经消失得无影无踪。起初，这个发现并未引起任何关注。毕竟自[owner.GetName]的先民首次举起望远镜注视星空以来，类似的现象并不罕见。在浩瀚的银河中，偶尔有星辰悄然熄灭，这本是再平常不过的事情。

十几天后，这位执着的用户又发现了另一颗消失的行星。而几天后，一片黄豆大小的明显的没有行星出现的区域醒目地展现在最新的星空图像中，那里原本璀璨的群星竟全数消失。对外发表声明，称这只是一个需要进一步研究的天文异常。但很快，事态就完全脱离了所谓“正常现象”的范畴。

两天后，一个庞大的黑影吞噬了近半幅观测图像。当科研人员们排除了设备故障后，一个可怕的事实浮出水面：根据科研人员的初步推测，这是一个正在接近[this.GetName]的神秘实体。初步计算显示，它体积巨大，行踪诡秘，移动却又惊人地敏捷。更令人不安的是，它既不符合任何已知天体的特征，也不像是任何文明造物的痕迹。而它的目标就是[this.GetName]。

第二天，紧急会议在[this.GetName]的科研基地召开。科学家们的讨论中紧张地推进着，而楼下的记者则堵在广场上，随时准备着采访。平时寂静的会议室中吵闹不堪，似乎每一个人都在为了尝试找出哪怕一点希望而陷入疯狂。

一阵狂风打破了寂静的酷暑。阵诡异的狂风撕裂了闷热的空气。气流来势汹汹，将记者们的器材高高卷起。将每一个人都吹得难以站立。紧接着，剧烈的地震将墙体砸出蛛网状的裂隙向远处蔓延。

顺着风的方向望去，不知什么时候，一张占据着大半天空的巨大脸庞赫然显现，巨大的蓝色双瞳如湖水一般清澈。她那湖水般澄澈的蓝色双瞳正俯视着这个渺小的世界。每一次眨眼，都伴随着震撼天地的巨响。狂暴的气流席卷着沙石、残枝、碎片、在广场上掀起一场死亡风暴。破碎的树木被连根拔起、扭曲变形的汽车被掀起，裹挟着各种被折断的设备，追猎着广场上无辜的人员。科研基地的玻璃在某一瞬间全部崩裂四散，无数锋利的碎片如同致命的箭雨，呼啸着射向高空。

当[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName]被发现时，一片尖锐的玻璃碎片已然贯穿[rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim]的胸膛。

与此同时，信号接入。
translation:
At the observatories of [this.GetName], every astronomical photograph shared across the network was a brilliant work of art. Innumerable twinkling stars wove the brocade of the galaxy, adorning the velvet night.
Until one day, an observant user spent hours spotting an anomaly: at the edge of a photograph, a once-bright star had vanished without a trace. At first, the discovery drew no attention. After all, ever since the ancestors of [owner.GetName] first turned telescopes toward the heavens, such occurrences were not unheard of. Across the vast galaxy, stars occasionally flickering out was a natural occurrence.

A dozen days later, this persistent user discovered another vanished star. Days after that, a soybean-sized dark void conspicuously appeared in the latest imagery, an area where the once-resplendent stars had entirely disappeared. An official statement was released, claiming it was merely an astronomical anomaly warranting further investigation. But soon, matters spiraled far beyond the realm of 'normal phenomena'.

Two days later, an immense silhouette swallowed nearly half of the entire observation frame. Once researchers ruled out instrument malfunction, a terrifying truth came to light: preliminary deductions revealed a mysterious entity approaching [this.GetName]. Initial calculations showed it possessed gargantuan proportions, an elusive presence, and startlingly agile movement. Even more unsettling, it matched no characteristics of known celestial bodies, nor bore any hallmarks of technological manufacture. And its destination was [this.GetName].

The following day, an emergency council convened at the research complex on [this.GetName]. Tense debates among scientists raged on while reporters swarmed the plaza outside, eager for interviews. The normally serene conference room dissolved into cacophony, everyone nearly driven mad in search of the faintest glimmer of hope.

A blast of gale shattered the sweltering heat. An eerie wind tore through the stagnant air. The incoming currents arrived with ferocious intensity, tossing reporters' equipment high into the air and knocking people off their feet. Violent tremors soon followed, spider-web cracks spreading across walls and paving stones into the distance.

Looking in the direction of the wind, an immense face had materialized, occupying more than half the firmament. Her clear blue pupils gazed down at this tiny world like tranquil lakes. With every blink came earth-shaking thuds. Turbulent gales swept up sand, debris, and broken branches, brewing a storm of destruction across the plaza. Splintered trees were uprooted, mangled automobiles were flung airborne alongside sheared equipment, imperiling innocent personnel across the grounds. In an instant, the glass facade of the research complex shattered into millions of shards, whistling into the sky like a lethal rain of arrows.

When [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetName] was finally located, a jagged shard of glass had already impaled [rainna_la_grande_this_scientist.GetHerHim] through the chest.

Simultaneously, a signal connects.
It's not entirely out of the question...

It is 'Tall Rainna'—though no one could have imagined she would be this colossal.

And my current role is that of an invader to your pathetic universe. 与此同时，地面上的人们可以清晰地看到天空中的蕾恩娜巨大的脸庞上露出可怖的笑容，尽管他们听不清楚蕾恩娜在说什么，紧张的氛围迎上了每一个人的心头。

平时空旷的街道被满载逃命的人的车辆堵塞得水泄不通，每一辆想要远离蕾恩娜的汽车都只得停在原地动弹不得。鸣笛的声音此起彼伏，却没有办法给逃生带来一点希望。

街道上顿时陷入一片混乱。人们仰望着天空中那张巨大的面庞，有的瘫坐在地，有的拼命奔逃，还有的则呆立原地，仿佛被恐惧冻结。警报声划破寂静的天际，但在这样的存在面前，这些声响显得如此苍白无力。

各地的应急系统相继启动。避难警报声在每个街区回荡，紧急避难所的标识不断闪烁。政府大楼前，军队和警察正在紧急部署，却没人知道该如何应对这样的威胁。新闻直播画面中，各个城市的天空都能看到那张俯视众生的巨脸，那双含着笑意的眼睛，仿佛在注视着一群渺小的低等生命。

城市中心，一些虔诚的信徒跪地祈祷，将这当作神明的显现。商业区里，人们抢购物资，争先恐后地囤积必需品。医院和避难所门前排起长队，家长们紧紧抱着自己的孩子。街道上四处都是被遗弃的车辆，它们的报警器此起彼伏地响着，更增添了几分末日般的氛围。

而在这片混乱之中，蕾恩娜的笑声依然通过通讯系统传来，她似乎很享受这场由她导演的混乱。她的巨足依然悬在天空中，就像一片巨大的阴影，笼罩着整个星球，让所有人都在等待着那转瞬即至的毁灭。

“啊啦~你们好像很害怕的样子呢？放心啦，我只是想找个地方站一下而已……”她的声音中带着天真的残酷，“不过，这么多人在逃命的样子，看起来还真有趣呢……”

蕾恩娜陶醉在自己的宏伟之中自言自语……

translation:
"Well, hello to you too~ Hehehe..."

From the other end of the signal, Rainna's innocent laughter drifts through.

"I just wonder: if I stomp down on your planet's surface, will you all still be fine? I'm really quite curious..."

And so, Rainna points the sole of her foot directly at the planet, poised at any moment to pick a spot and step down.

Meanwhile, the people on the surface can clearly see a terrifying smile spread across Rainna's colossal face in the sky. Even if they cannot hear what she is saying, a suffocating dread grips every single heart.

Streets that were once open and quiet are gridlocked with vehicles crammed with fleeing citizens, every car trying in vain to escape Rainna, left stranded in place. Horns blare frantically in every direction, yet offer not a shred of hope for salvation.

The streets dissolve into sheer pandemonium. Staring up at that gigantic face dominating the heavens, some collapse limp on the pavement, others run blindly, and still others stand frozen where they are, paralyzed with terror. Sirens pierce the sky, but before an existence like hers, their wails are utterly frail and useless.

Emergency response systems ignite worldwide. Evacuation alarms howl across every district, and shelters flash their beacons incessantly. Outside government buildings, military forces and police deploy in desperate haste, yet no one has any idea how to counter such a threat. On live news broadcasts across the globe, skies above every metropolis are filled with that towering face looking down upon mortal life—those smiling eyes regarding them as though watching insignificant lower organisms.

In city squares, pious believers kneel in prayer, taking this as the manifestation of a divine being. In commercial centers, frantic crowds loot and scramble to hoard supplies. Endless lines form outside hospitals and shelters as parents cling desperately to their children. Abandoned cars litter the streets, their alarms shrieking in chaotic unison, adding to the apocalyptic dread.

Amidst this widespread chaos, Rainna's laughter continues to hum over the comms. She seems to thoroughly savor this grand turmoil she has orchestrated. Her gigantic foot still looms suspended in the sky like an enormous shadow smothering the entire world, leaving everyone in agonizing anticipation of imminent doom.

"Ara~ you all seem so terrified! Don't worry, I just want to find a place to stand on..." Her voice bears an innocent cruelty. "Though seeing so many little people scrambling for their lives really is quite entertaining..."

Intoxicated by her own grandeur, Rainna murmurs to herself...

"Mmm, looks like this tiny planet is actually quite neat and tidy. Now, where should I step?"
I don't want to... just yet...

“很简单哦，我只想在你们的星球上留下一个小小的足印而已。作为回报，我保证不会再伤害你们~”

话音未落，她的巨足就悄然移动到了行星上空。那雪白的足底几乎遮蔽了整片天空，让整个大陆陷入了不自然的黑暗。足底的每一道纹路都清晰可见，比城市的街道还要宽阔。

“嘛，这个交易蛮划算的，不是吗？”

在这片可怖的阴影下，地面上的一切都显得如此渺小。人们仰望着天空，看着那个足以轻易毁灭他们的存在，正在用温柔的语气谈论着“公平交易”。

“嘛……真是一项公平的提议呢……”
translation:
"Hehehe..."

From the other side of the comms comes Rainna's irrepressible giggle, a voice combining innocence and cheer with a dangerous anticipation.

"Well... since you asked so politely and respectfully, then... granting a tiny request of mine wouldn't be too much to ask, right?..."

She draws out her words, her voice rich with mischievous excitement, as though struck by an amusing idea.

"Hehe... how about we make a fair trade?~"

In the dark vacuum of space, Rainna's form suddenly manifests. Galactic starlight coats her fair skin in a dreamy luminescence, making her titanic silhouette seem all the more unreal.

"It's very simple: I only want to leave a little footprint on your planet. In return, I promise not to hurt you any further~"

Her gigantic sole suddenly eclipses the heavens, poised to press downward.

Before her words even finish, her giant foot has quietly positioned itself right above the planet. That snow-white sole blocks out nearly the entire sky, plunging whole continents into an unnatural twilight. Every groove and crease of her sole is distinctly visible, wider than any city boulevard.

"Well, that's quite a bargain, isn't it?"

Beneath that dreadful shadow, everything on the surface looks infinitesimal. People gaze upward at an entity capable of wiping them out with trivial ease, who speaks of a "fair trade" in such gentle, playful tones.

"Mmm... what a fair proposal indeed..."

original:
“欸——这是要宣战了吗？难不成……”

蕾恩娜优雅地抬起修长的腿，弯曲足弓，将她白皙的足趾展示在这颗星球面前。每一个轻微的动作都让大气层泛起涟漪，那完美的足型投下的阴影足以笼罩一片大陆。

“难不成我想要在这颗小星球上留下标记的计划暴露了？唔！那可真的是太不好了……”

她灵巧地活动着足趾，这看似随意的动作却在大气中掀起一阵温和的飓风，横扫过整片大陆。城市的尖塔在这阵气流中摇摇欲坠，树木纷纷弯折，海面掀起滔天巨浪。

“那……就将计就计吧~”
translation:
"Eh—are you declaring war on me? Could it be..."

Rainna gracefully lifts her long leg, arching her foot and displaying her fair toes before the planet. Every slight movement causes ripples through the atmosphere, the shadow cast by her flawless foot enough to blanket an entire continent.

"Could it be that my plan to leave a little mark on this tiny planet was exposed? Ugh! That is really too bad..."

She nimbly wiggles her toes; that seemingly casual motion stirs a gentle hurricane within the atmosphere that sweeps across the continent. City spires shudder and sway in the gale, trees bend and snap, and colossal waves churn across the ocean.

"Well... then I'll just turn your plan to my advantage~"

original: 成功激起了她的欲望，真的能停下来吗？
translation: Having aroused her desire, can she truly be stopped?

original: 蝼蚁般的军队面对如此悬殊的对手无异于飞蛾扑火……
translation: An ant-like army facing such an overwhelming opponent is nothing but moths to a flame...

original:
“啊啦啦~当然可以......”

蕾恩娜咯咯地笑着，那银铃般的笑声在通讯器中回荡。她似乎对刚才自己不经意间将大气搅得一团糟毫无察觉，或者说，她压根就不在意。她那巨大的面庞凑近这颗渺小的行星，湖泊般清澈的蓝色眼眸闪烁着好奇的光芒，将这个星球的每一个细节都尽收眼底。

每当她轻轻眨眼，那如同城市般巨大的睫毛便会扰动大气层，掀起持续不断的狂风。地面上的树木被吹得东倒西歪，海面上巨浪翻涌，但她似乎完全没有意识到自己的存在本身就是一场灾难。

“嘿嘿嘿……”

她优雅地蜷起修长的双腿，用纤细的手指轻柔地抚摸着自己微微攒动的足趾。那雪白的足底在星光下泛着柔和的光泽，每一道纹路都如同山谷般清晰。她看起来心情极好，笑眯眯地歪着脑袋，就像一个得到了新玩具的孩子。

“你们说……”她的声音中带着期待和些许狡黠，“我的足趾漂亮吗？”

她将足底托在双手上，在太空中轻轻地扭动着那十根足趾。每一根足趾的活动都带起微妙的气流变化，让地面上的气象观测站陷入混乱。她似乎在等待着什么出乎意料的回应，那双清澈的眼睛中闪烁着危险的光芒。

“我倒是很好奇……”她俯视着这颗星球，声音突然变得轻柔而危险。“这个星球踩起来会是什么样的感觉呢……”

她的足底缓缓从手中抬起，在大气层外划出一道优美的弧线。那完美的足型投下的阴影如同一片移动的黑暗，扫过一座又一座城市。每当阴影经过，街道上的人们都会惊恐地仰望天空，看着那个随时可能落下的“审判”。

“作为朋友……”她的声音中带着天真的残酷，“你们应该不介意让我试试吧？”

空气中弥漫着令人窒息的紧张感。所有人都意识到，这个看似友善的提议，实际上根本不是一个可以拒绝的选择。
translation:
"Ara ara~ of course you can..."

Rainna giggles, her bell-like laughter resonating through the communicator. She seems utterly oblivious to the havoc she inadvertently wreaked upon the atmosphere earlier—or rather, she simply couldn't care less. Her titanic face leans in close to the diminutive planet, lake-clear blue eyes glimmering with curiosity, drinking in every minute feature of this world.

Whenever she blinks, her eyelashes—vast as cities—stir the atmosphere, whipping up relentless gales. Trees on the surface are blown flat, ocean swells surge violently, yet she remains wholly oblivious that her sheer presence is itself a catastrophe.

"Hehehe..."

Gracefully curling her slender legs, she gently strokes her wriggling toes with delicate fingers. Her snow-white soles glow with a soft luster beneath the starlight, every crease as distinct as a mountain valley. She seems in tremendous spirits, tilting her head with a beaming smile like a child who has just received a brand-new toy.

"Tell me..." Her voice carries anticipation and a hint of cunning, "Are my toes pretty?"

Cradling her soles in both hands, she gently flexes those ten toes in space. The movement of each toe generates subtle shifts in air currents, throwing surface meteorological stations into chaos. She seems to anticipate an unexpected response, a perilous glint sparkling within her clear eyes.

"I'm really quite curious..." Looking down at the world, her voice suddenly turns soft and dangerous. "What does it feel like to step on this planet, I wonder..."

Slowly releasing her feet from her hands, her sole traces an elegant arc outside the atmosphere. The shadow cast by that perfect foot glides like a shifting darkness across city after city. Wherever the shadow passes, terrified people on the streets look up at the sky, beholding a 'judgment' that could drop at any moment.

"As friends..." Her tone bears an innocent cruelty, "you wouldn't mind letting me give it a try, would you?"

A suffocating tension chokes the air. Everyone realizes that this seemingly friendly suggestion is in fact not a choice one can ever refuse.

original: 拿出可以谈判的所有筹码，能比得上她的一根足趾吗？
translation: Can all the bargaining chips you muster even compare to a single one of her toes?

original: 怠慢了你的新朋友，她会很生气的……
translation: If you slight your new friend, she will be very angry...

original:
听到这个回答，蕾恩娜缓缓闭上了那双明亮的眼眸。她的面容在星光下显得格外柔和，嘴角浮现出一抹优雅而满意的微笑。她那充满灵性的巨大身躯在太空中轻轻舒展，仿佛在用整个存在去感受来自这颗渺小星球上无数生命的气息。

这个出乎意料的回答，显然让她心情愉悦。

片刻后，她睁开双眼，那湖泊般清澈的蓝色瞳孔中闪烁着满足的光芒。她的双臂平静地交叉在胸前，就像是在摆出某种无比神圣的姿态。她平静地凝视着这个微小的世界，声音变得轻柔而庄重。

“看来这个宇宙的一角，居然有对我的崇拜……”

她试图模仿那些古老典籍中记载的神明形象，摆出一副庄严肃穆的姿态。但她声音中那按捺不住的顽皮和兴奋。

“那么，作为你们自古以来……” 她故意停顿了一下，俏皮地眨了眨眼，“不，也许是新晋的至高之神，我欣然接受你们卑微的崇拜。”

她优雅地调整着姿势，长发在无重力的太空中如瀑布般飘散。

“而作为回应……”她的声音突然变得神秘而期待，“身为神明，若不展示一下我的伟大，岂不是有些遗憾呢……”

说着，她屈起修长的左腿，将那如玉般洁白无瑕的足底抬至面前。透过朦胧的大气层，那完美的足型投下了一片遮天蔽日的阴影，笼罩了大半个星球。整个世界瞬间陷入黑暗，仿佛夜幕突然降临。

“让我想想……”她的声音透过通讯器传来，带着几分戏谑，“神明该如何向信徒展示恩泽呢？”

她的足趾在空中轻轻晃动，每一个微小的动作都让地面上的人们心跳加速。那遮蔽天空的足底如同一把悬在头顶的重锤，随时可能落下。
translation:
Hearing this answer, Rainna slowly closes her bright eyes. Her face appears exceptionally gentle under the starlight, an elegant and satisfied smile gracing her lips. Her ethereal long hair spreads softly across the vacuum like a flowing river of stars, exuding a sacred, inviolable aura.

At this moment, she no longer resembles a mischievous girl; she truly reveals a transcendent divinity. That pure, grand, unapproachable majesty fills everyone observing through scientific instruments with profound awe.

"A goddess, you say..."

Her voice turns soft and distant, devoid of its playful edge. Each word resounds through the atmosphere like a morning bell struck in the cosmos, clear and solemn, soothing the panicked creatures below who trembled in dread.

"Since you revere me as your goddess..."

Slowly opening her eyes, profound light swirls within those sky-blue orbs. She gracefully raises one hand, resting it lightly against her chest in an ancient, stately gesture.

"Then... demonstrate your sincerity."

A faint, enigmatic smile graces the corner of her lips—a transcendent saintliness that still carries an elusive hint of playfulness.

"Let me see how you intend to serve your goddess."

original: 我们愿意接受神明的恩泽……
translation: We are willing to receive our goddess's divine grace...

original: 顺从神明的意志，或许能换来些许怜悯……
translation: Submitting to divine will might perhaps earn a modicum of mercy...

original: 请女神降下您的神迹吧！

original: 神当然愿意降下更多神迹！
translation: A goddess is always delighted to bestow more miracles!

original:
“嘿嘿嘿……你们也好哦~嘛，你们一定很期待我的到来吧……”

蕾恩娜咯咯地笑着，像是一个顽皮的孩子。她那巨大的身躯在太空中优雅地漂浮，长发在真空中无重力地飘散，如同一片星云般绚丽。

“你们这群渺小的生命，肯定很期待我降下的恩泽吧~”

她白皙修长的手指在行星上空缓缓伸展，如同一座横亘天际的巨塔。指尖的粉色指甲在阳光下闪烁着微光，映照在大气层上，给整片天空都染上了诡异的粉红色调。

“嗯……选择哪里比较好呢？”

她的手指在大气层外轻轻划动，带起一片片云层的扰动。地面上，人们惊恐地望着天空中那巨大的手指投下的阴影。

紧急避难警报的尖啸声划破天际，在每个街区的广播喇叭中回荡。这原本为了应对自然灾害设计的系统，此刻显得如此苍白而无助。街道上的电子显示屏不断闪烁着红色的警告标识，却没人知道该往哪里逃。

城市陷入一片混乱。中央广场上，一群虔诚的信徒跪倒在地，高举双手祈祷，将这当作神明的显现。他们的祷告声与哭泣声交织在一起，却被周围此起彼伏的尖叫声淹没。街道上，人们争相涌向地铁站和地下避难所，推搡中不时传来哭声与怒骂。更多的人则像是被施了定身咒一般呆立在原地，仰望着天空中那不可思议的巨手，瞳孔中倒映着末日般的景象。

“你们看起来很害怕嘛……不过不用担心啦，我只是想稍微……”

“玩一玩而已啦……”
translation:
"Hehehe... hello to you too~ Well, you must have been looking forward to my arrival, haven't you..."

Rainna giggles like a naughty child. Her gigantic form floats gracefully in space, long hair billowing weightlessly in the vacuum like a radiant nebula.

"You tiny beings must be eagerly awaiting the blessings I bring~"

Her fair, slender finger slowly stretches out above the planet like a titanic tower spanning the horizon. The pink nail on her fingertip shimmers under the sunlight, reflecting off the atmosphere and dyeing the entire sky in an eerie pink hue.

"Hmm... where should I pick?"

Her finger traces lightly outside the atmosphere, stirring ripples across the clouds. Below, citizens watch in sheer terror as the enormous shadow of that finger falls upon the land.

The shriek of emergency evacuation sirens pierces the heavens, reverberating through loudspeakers in every district. A system designed for natural disasters now seems tragically frail and helpless. Electronic display boards along streets flash endless red warnings, yet nobody knows where to flee.

The city plunges into utter bedlam. In the central plaza, a crowd of devout believers falls to their knees with hands raised in prayer, taking this as a divine visitation. Their prayers and sobs mingle together, only to be swallowed by shrieks from all around. In the streets, people scramble into subway stations and underground bunkers, shouts and wept curses echoing amid the frantic shoving. Many more stand transfixed as if paralyzed, gazing up at that impossible giant hand, their eyes reflecting an apocalyptic sight.

"You look so scared... but don't worry, I just want to..."

"Play around a little bit, that's all..."

original:
“嘛……”

蕾恩娜的声音中带着玩味的笑意。在漆黑的太空中，她那巨大的身影突然显现，如同一座移动的星云般壮丽而可怕。星光在她白皙的肌肤上跳跃，为这个可怖的场景增添了几分诡异的美感。

“哼哼，既然你们不想让我伤害你们……”

她歪着头，在朦胧的云层背后露出一个天真而危险的笑容。

“那想必是有什么厉害的武器藏着没让我看到吧~”

通讯器中传来她轻快的声音，却让每个听到的人都背脊发凉。她的身体优雅地在太空中旋转了一周，像是在水中嬉戏的少女，只是她的每个动作都让整个星球的人心惊胆战。

“哦？你们不会……只会示弱这一招吧？”

她的声音变得危险，故意拖长了语调。

“那我为什么要在意你们的请求呢？”

蕾恩娜伸出一根修长的手指，在大气层外灵巧地画着圈，寻找着落点。每一个动作都优雅得像是在跳舞，却让地面上的军事指挥官们冷汗直流。他们引以为傲的防御系统在她面前，就像是玩具一般可笑。
translation:
"Well..."

Rainna's voice carries a playful amusement. In the pitch-black cosmos, her gigantic figure suddenly reveals itself, as magnificent and terrifying as a roaming nebula. Starlight dances across her fair skin, lending an uncanny beauty to this dreadful scene.

"Hehehe, since you don't want me to hurt you..."

Tilting her head, she flashes an innocent yet perilous smile behind the hazy clouds.

"Then surely you must have some formidable weapon hidden away that I haven't seen yet~"

Her cheery voice filters through the comms, sending shivers down the spine of everyone who hears it. Her body twirls gracefully in the void like a maiden playing in the water, yet every single motion strikes terror into the hearts of the entire planet.

"Oh? Don't tell me... playing weak is your only trick?"

Her tone grows menacing, deliberately dragging out each syllable.

"Then why should I care about your little pleas?"

Rainna extends a slender finger, tracing deft circles just outside the atmosphere as she picks her target. Every gesture is as graceful as a dance, yet it drenches the military commanders on the ground in cold sweat. The planetary defense systems they took such pride in seem utterly laughable before her.

original:
“呀呀呀……你们这群小家伙，居然是这样欢迎访客的，服务态度真差！”

蕾恩娜的表情从天真转为顽皮，那变化让人不寒而栗。她俯下身，闭起左眼，将右眼凑近行星表面。那巨大的淡蓝色瞳孔取代了整片天空，如同一颗悬浮在天际的巨大蓝宝石。她每一次眨眼，都让整个大气层剧烈震颤，美丽的云层在这冲击下支离破碎，化作混乱的气流席卷着城市表面。

“欸——我怎么没有看到你们的军队呢？难道是……你们是跟我开玩笑的？”

她伸出一根修长的食指，在那苍白的指影下，整个星球的军队正在集结。装甲车的履带在地面碾出沉重的轰鸣，战机编队划过天际，导弹发射井缓缓开启。但这一切在她指尖的阴影中，显得如此微不足道。

“还是说……你们的军队所在跟我开玩笑呢？”

“嘛，我可不喜欢玩笑~”
translation:
"My, my, my... you little creatures certainly have terrible hospitality! What awful service for a visitor!"

Rainna's expression shifts from innocent to wicked, a transformation that sends chills down the spine. Leaning down, she closes her left eye and presses her right eye close to the planetary surface. That colossal pale-blue pupil takes over the entire sky like a titanic sapphire suspended in the heavens. Every time she blinks, the atmosphere shudders violently; exquisite cloud formations shatter under the shockwaves into turbulent vortices sweeping across metropolitan sprawls.

"Eh—how come I don't see your army? Could it be... you were just kidding with me?"

She extends a slender index finger. Beneath that pale shadow, the planet's entire armed forces are mobilizing. Tank treads thunder against pavement, squadrons of fighter jets streak across the sky, and missile silos slowly open. Yet beneath the looming shadow of her fingertip, all of it looks pitifully negligible.

"Or is your military itself just a joke?"

"Well, I really don't like jokes~"

original:
“啊咧啊咧，乱攀关系可不好哦~我蕾恩娜也不是和谁都交朋友的哦……”

蕾恩娜将巨大的脸庞贴近这颗渺小的星球，那双湖泊般清澈的眼眸中闪烁着玩味的光芒。她仔细打量着这个微型世界，就像孩童在观察玻璃球里的微观景致。她的长发在真空中无重力地飘散，如同一片梦幻的星云，每一缕发丝的轻微摆动都在大气层中激起涟漪。

“嘛，不过……”她的声音突然变得俏皮，“也不是不可以哦~”

她优雅地伸出一根修长的食指，那根指尖在太空中划出优美的弧线。当它悬停在大陆上方时，就像一座从天而降的巨柱，遮天蔽日。指尖投下的阴影足以覆盖半个大陆，让那片原本繁华的首都区瞬间陷入漆黑。

街道上的灯光在这突如其来的黑暗中显得格外微弱，如同萤火虫般闪烁。人们仰望天空，看到的只是那遮蔽一切的巨大指尖。它悬在那里，静静地，却让每个人都感受到了死亡的阴影。

她歪着头，指尖在空中轻轻晃动，声音中带着危险的甜蜜。“突然好像在这颗星球上做一个记号，你们不会太在意吧？”
translation:
"Ara, ara, trying to cozy up to me won't work~ I, Rainna, don't just become friends with anyone, you know..."

Rainna presses her colossal face close to this minuscule planet, her lake-clear eyes gleaming with amused fascination. She examines this miniature world just like a child inspecting a microcosm inside a glass marble. Her long hair billows weightlessly in the void like a dreamlike nebula, the faint sway of every strand sending ripples through the atmosphere.

Her serene pupils, calm as mirror-like lakes, reflect half the world—dense metropolitan clusters, meandering rivers, undulating mountain ranges, all looking like dust clinging to continents. Whenever she lightly blinks, eyelashes vast as cities agitate the entire atmosphere, violently shaking the earth below. Buildings sway precipitously, windows shatter across districts, and sirens wail incessantly.

Her every breath commands the fate of the entire planet, inflicting a suffocating pressure on all below. The moss-like details sprawling across the planetary crust—cities, highways, harbors—tremble violently in her respiration, as if ocean waves could swallow the land and skyscrapers could be uprooted at any moment.

Such a crushing disparity in power brings her immense delight, an involuntary curve gracing her lips.

"Well, though..." Her voice suddenly turns playful, "I suppose it's not entirely out of the question~"

She elegantly extends a slender index finger, tracing a graceful arc through space. As it hovers over the continent, it resembles a titanic pillar descending from the heavens, eclipsing the sky. The shadow cast by that fingertip spans half the continent, immediately plunging the prosperous capital region into darkness.

Streetlights in the sudden gloom appear pitifully faint, flickering like fireflies. Looking up, citizens see only that all-eclipsing fingertip suspended motionless in the sky, casting the cold shadow of mortality over every soul.

Tilting her head, she gently bobs her fingertip in the air, her voice dripping with dangerous sweetness. "I suddenly feel like leaving a little mark on this planet. You wouldn't mind too much, would you?"

original:
听到这个回答，蕾恩娜微微一愣，那双清澈的蓝色眼眸中闪过一丝意外。她半眯起眼睛，饶有兴致地凝视着这颗渺小的星球。

“你们这群小生命崇拜我的多了去了……”她小声嘀咕着，声音中带着些许自得。然而这嘀咕却如同雷鸣般在整个大气层中回荡，震耳欲聋的音波让地面剧烈震颤。“没想到今天还能遇到知道我名号的呢……”

她的声音中带着一丝惊喜，巨大的面庞更加贴近星球，仔细打量着这个微小的世界。在她眼中，密集的城市群不过是一片片细小的光点，而那些高耸的建筑，也不过是地表上微不足道的凸起。

“不过……”她歪着头，长发在太空中优雅地飘动。“这么小的星球，想让我真正降临，恐怕不太现实吧？”

她伸出修长白皙的食指，优雅地轻抵在自己粉嫩的上唇，做出思考的姿态。那个动作如此优美，却让所有目睹这一幕的人心跳骤停——因为那根手指，足以轻易毁灭一切。

“嘛……”她的眼神突然落在那片繁华的大陆上，嘴角勾起一抹顽皮的笑容，“这样吧。”

她的食指从唇边移开，在太空中划出一道优美的弧线。指尖悬停在那片大陆的上方，投下了遮天蔽日的阴影。

“用我的一根手指，稍微打个招呼，应该也算是降临了吧~”

她的声音中充满危险的诱惑。那根食指在大陆上空轻轻晃动，就像是在挑选最完美的落点。每一次微小的移动，都让阴影扫过一座又一座城市,让无数人陷入绝望的等待。

“你们说……”她的眼中闪烁着危险的光芒，“我应该轻轻地碰一下呢，还是稍微用点力呢？”

她的指尖开始缓缓下降，巨大的威压逼近地表。

“作为信徒……”她轻声低语，声音却震动着整个世界，“你们应该很欢迎神明的触碰吧？”
translation:
Hearing this reply, Rainna pauses slightly, a flicker of surprise crossing her clear blue eyes. Half-closing them, she gazes with keen interest at the minuscule planet.

"There are plenty of tiny lifeforms who worship me..." she mutters softly, pride evident in her tone. Yet that soft mutter reverberates through the atmosphere like thunder, deafening shockwaves shaking the earth. "Never thought I'd run into someone today who actually knows my title..."

Delight enters her voice as she presses her titanic face even closer to inspect this tiny world. In her eyes, sprawling urban clusters are merely clusters of faint specks of light, and towering skyscrapers nothing more than negligible bumps on the crust.

"Still..." She tilts her head, long tresses floating gracefully in the cosmos. "For such a tiny world, expecting my true advent in full might be a bit unrealistic, don't you think?"

Extending a slender, fair index finger, she rests it elegantly against her soft upper lip in contemplation. The gesture is exquisite, yet it stops the heart of every living soul beholding it—for that single finger is capable of wiping out everything.

"Well..." Her gaze suddenly falls upon the bustling continent, a mischievous smile playing on her lips. "How about this?"

Her finger pulls away from her lips and traces an elegant arc in space, hovering directly over the continent and casting a sky-blotting shadow.

"Greeting you with just one of my fingers should count as an advent too, right?~"

Her voice drips with perilous allure. That index finger wiggles gently over the continent, as if choosing the most perfect spot to strike. Every minute shift sends shadows sweeping across city after city, plunging millions into agonizing suspense.

"Tell me..." A dangerous glint flashes in her eyes, "should I touch it gently, or press down with just a little bit of force?"

Her fingertip begins its gradual descent, crushing pressure bearing down upon the world.

"As believers..." she murmurs, her whisper trembling the entire globe, "surely you welcome the touch of your goddess, don't you?"

original:
“嘛——看来是遇到对手了呢~”

蕾恩娜兴奋地屈起足趾，整个身体都激动得微微颤抖。她那双湖泊般的眼眸中闪烁着期待的光芒。

“小家伙们……”

她将巨大的面庞凑近这颗被足底包围的星球，脸上流露出狡黠而愉悦的笑容。她伸出纤细的手指，轻柔地从自己光滑的足底划过，那个挑逗性的触碰让足底被丝袜包裹的肌肤微微颤动，仿佛在期待着即将到来的“游戏”。

“你们可是成功激起了我的兴趣呢~”

与此同时，星球表面已经陷入一片混乱。

全球各地的军事基地同时启动，导弹发射井打开，战机编队呼啸升空，激光武器对准天空。这是[Owner.GetSpeciesName]文明最后的尊严之战——即便敌人是如此不可战胜的存在。

无数的导弹拖着火焰的尾迹冲向天际，在大气层边缘爆炸，试图阻挡两边那逼近的足底。激光束如同光之长矛刺向那雪白的丝袜。战舰齐射的能量炮在足底表面绽放出璀璨的光芒。

但这一切，对蕾恩娜来说……

“嗯……好细腻的攻击，感受到了呢~”

她轻声呢喃着，声音中带着满足的愉悦。那些足以毁灭城市的武器，在她光滑细腻的白丝足底上，不过是温柔的按摩。

“只不过这种小小的瘙痒真是令人舒适呢……”

她咯咯地笑着，微微晃动足趾，让更多的攻击落在足底最敏感的部位。每一次爆炸都像是在挠痒痒，让她忍不住想要更多的“饱和打击”。

“那作为回报……”她的声音突然变得危险，“我可要反击咯~”

两只巨大的足底开始压下。

首先触及星球表面的是足弓的边缘。那丝袜贴合着的柔软而充满弹性的肌肤轻轻贴在大气层上，如同一对温暖的天幕。接触的瞬间，整个星球都感受到了难以承受的压力。

足底继续下沉，开始接触地表。

最先感受到压力的是地球两边最大的大陆。板块在巨大的压力下开始崩裂，发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣。海洋被挤压，掀起前所未有的超级海啸，高达数千米的巨浪横扫其他残余大陆。

“阿啦~看来这颗星球要撑不住了呢……”

蕾恩娜满意地低语。她能清楚地感受到足底下那个微小世界的每一次挣扎。

足底继续加压。

星球表面开始出现第一道裂缝。那条裂缝从赤道附近的海洋中绽放，如同玻璃上的裂纹般迅速蔓延，无数的建筑群伴随着碎裂的土地调入缝隙之中。裂缝的宽度足以吞没整座城市，深度直达地壳深处。炽热的岩浆从裂缝中喷涌而出，在足底的压迫下形成诡异的火焰喷泉。

紧接着是第二道、第三道……

无数条巨大的裂缝如同蛛网般在星球表面蔓延。大陆板块在这难以想象的压力下开始断裂、错位。山脉崩塌，平原下沉，海底隆起。整个星球的地质结构在这温柔且致命的夹击中走向崩溃。

“嘻嘻，这足底被摩擦得痒痒的，真是舒服呢~”

蕾恩娜愉快地说着，轻轻蹭动足底。这个看似温柔的动作，却让星球表面的破坏更加剧烈。足底的摩擦带走了地表的一切——城市、森林、海洋——都在这柔软的肌肤下化为齑粉。

碎片从裂缝中迸溅而出。那些是被挤压出来的地壳碎块、蒸发的海水、以及无数文明的残骸。

蕾恩娜满意地笑着，她的足底继续缓慢而坚定地收紧……
translation:
"Well now—looks like I've met a worthy challenger~"

Rainna curls her toes in excitement, her whole body trembling slightly with anticipation. Eager light glimmers within her lake-like eyes.

"Little ones..."

She brings her colossal face close to the planet flanked by her soles, a sly, delightful grin spreading across her features. Extending a slender finger, she gently traces it across her smooth sole; that teasing touch sends a subtle shiver through the stocking-clad skin of her sole, as if eagerly awaiting the forthcoming "game."

"You've certainly managed to pique my interest~"

Meanwhile, the surface has descended into total turmoil.

Military bases across the globe activate simultaneously: missile silos swing open, fighter wings scream into the sky, and laser arrays point straight up. This is the [Owner.GetSpeciesName] civilization's final battle for dignity—even if their foe is an impossibly invincible titan.

Countless missiles trail plumes of fire into the heavens, detonating at the edge of the atmosphere in a frantic bid to halt the advancing soles on either side. Laser beams strike like lances of light against the white silk stockings. Broadside salvos from planetary battleships burst into brilliant flares across the surface of her soles.

Yet to Rainna, all of this is...

"Mmm... such delicate attacks, I can really feel them~"

She murmurs softly, her voice filled with satisfied pleasure. Weapons capable of wiping out entire metropolises are nothing more than a soothing massage against her smooth, stocking-clad soles.

"And this tiny bit of tickling is so comfortable..."

She giggles, wiggling her toes slightly to direct more barrages onto the most sensitive spots of her soles. Every blast is like a delightful tickle, making her crave even more "saturation strikes."

"So in return..." Her voice suddenly takes a perilous turn, "I'm going to counterattack~"

The two gigantic soles begin to press inward.

The first parts to make contact with the planetary surface are the edges of her arches. Soft, supple skin wrapped tightly in silk presses gently against the atmosphere, resembling a pair of warm celestial canopies. The instant contact is made, the entire planet reels beneath unbearable pressure.

The soles continue to descend, making contact with the crust.

The first to feel the brunt of the force are the largest continents on opposing sides of the world. Tectonic plates crack and buckle under the immense pressure, unleashing deafening rumbles. Oceans are squeezed dry, triggering unprecedented megatsunamis with waves kilometers high sweeping across remaining landmasses.

"Ara~ looks like this little planet can't hold out much longer..."

Rainna whispers in satisfaction. She can distinctly feel every struggle of the tiny world trapped beneath her soles.

The soles press even harder.

The first catastrophic fissure appears on the surface. Blossoming from equatorial oceans, it spreads rapidly like cracks on shattered glass, swallowing entire cities as the earth crumbles beneath them. The chasm is wide enough to engulf whole nations and deep enough to pierce the mantle. Blistering magma erupts from the tear, forming bizarre fountains of fire beneath the crushing pressure of her soles.

Then comes the second fracture, and the third...

Countless gargantuan rifts spread across the globe like a spider's web. Continents shatter and displace under the unimaginable force. Mountains collapse, plains subside, and ocean beds heave upward. The entire geological structure of the planet collapses within this tender yet lethal vice.

"Heehee, the friction on my soles tickles so delightfully, it feels wonderful~"

Rainna coos happily, gently rubbing her soles against the world. That seemingly gentle caress only accelerates the planetary devastation. The grinding of her soles sweeps away everything on the surface—cities, forests, oceans—all pulverized to dust against her soft skin.

Debris erupts from the fissures: extruded chunks of the planetary crust, vaporized oceans, and the shattered remnants of an entire civilization.

Rainna smiles contentedly as her soles continue their slow, unyielding squeeze...

translation:
"Mmm... not bad~"

Rainna's voice suddenly softens, her gigantic eyes curling into crescents. An innocent, maidenly smile blooms across her face, sweet enough to seemingly dissolve all hostility.

She stretches lazily, her flawless curves looking exceptionally alluring beneath the starlight. Her mood has genuinely improved quite a bit.

"Since you apologized with such earnest sincerity—have you figured out how you're going to compensate me?"

"Well, if you haven't made up your minds..." She giggles, "I have plenty of ideas of my own~"

"Better think quickly~" Her voice turns demanding, laced with impatience. "My expectations for your compensation won't wait forever. And remember..."

Leaning down, her colossal face draws almost flush against the planet.

"You must show true sincerity~ If you disappoint me..." Smiling faintly, she gives her soles a gentle nudge, "I might not be able to hold back from using... just a tiny bit of force~"

The air seems to freeze solid.

And Rainna rests her chin in her hands, waiting with keen amusement as if anticipating a delightful performance. Her soles remain suspended right there, ready at a moment's notice...

translation:
Hearing this answer, Rainna suddenly falls silent.

She slowly closes her eyes, slender fingertips resting lightly together before her chest. Her flowing hair drifts outward in weightless space like a dreamlike nebula. Her expression turns serene and transcendent, as though she truly were a deity from ancient myth.

A fleeting stillness falls, as if the cosmos itself has held its breath.

When she opens her eyes once more, a profound and enigmatic luminescence emanates from those lake-blue irises. The void itself seems to grow solemn in her presence, ethereal echoes faintly reverberating across the stars.

Gone is her earlier mockery, supplanted by a transcendent and commanding holiness. Gazing down at the tiny planet, her voice turns solemn and profound:

"If you are willing to submit to me and cast aside your hollow faiths..."

Her voice rolls through space, ringing with indisputable authority.

"...then forgiveness shall be granted."

She holds this majestic pose, hands still pressed elegantly before her chest. Starlight converges into a glowing halo behind her, making her truly appear like a descended deity.

Silence lingers for a few seconds.

Then, the corner of her mouth curls upward slightly into a nearly imperceptible smile.

"So then..." she murmurs softly, that solemn gravity already quietly fading, "what is your choice?"

She tilts her head, that single motion instantly infusing the sacred ambiance with a maiden's playful whimsy.
