original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗庞大得难以想象的星球之上。

这颗星球的规模远超我们任何已知的观测参照系，周围的一切都大到无法用常规手段测量。飞船的仪器在着陆后立刻捕捉到了一种强烈的信号，频率稳定，来源方向清晰，像是某种刻意向外广播的东西。

科研人员开始架设接收器，准备对这个信号进行解码。

然而就在这时，仪器的另一个读数引起了一名科研人员的注意——在那个强烈信号的背后，有一道极为微弱的次级信号，几乎被完全淹没，像是被刻意压制或隐藏在噪声之中。

如果不是有人特意去找，根本不会注意到它的存在。
translation:
Our ship touched down on this unimaginably colossal world.

The planet's sheer scale defied every known frame of reference; everything around us was too vast to be measured by conventional means. Upon landing, our instruments immediately picked up a powerful transmission—steady in frequency and clear in direction, like an intentional broadcast radiating outward.

The researchers set up receivers, preparing to decode the signal.

Yet just then, another instrument readout caught a scientist's eye—hidden behind that potent broadcast was a secondary signal, exceedingly faint and nearly drowned out, as if suppressed or deliberately concealed within the background noise.

Unless one were actively searching for it, its presence would have gone entirely unnoticed.

original:
这颗星球依然庞大无比，周围的一切同样大到无法观测。

与上一个遗址相似，这里也存在着强烈的信号，来源稳定，频率规律，像是某种刻意向外广播的信息。有了上一次的经验，科研人员在架设接收器的同时，没有忘记对背景噪声进行精细扫描。

果然，在那道强烈信号的阴影之下，隐藏着一道几乎无法察觉的微弱次级信号，像是被人刻意压在最深处，不想让人找到。
translation:
This world remains unimaginably immense, its surrounding features far too vast for normal observation.

Much like the previous site, a powerful signal was detected here—stable, regular, and clearly intended as an outward broadcast. Armed with prior experience, the researchers did not forget to meticulously scan the background noise while deploying their receivers.

Sure enough, lurking in the shadow of that booming transmission was a nearly imperceptible secondary signal, buried deep as if deliberately hidden away from prying eyes.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗庞大的星球之上。

目光所及之处，巨型建筑群的轮廓在地平线上依次排开，规模宏大，工艺精良。与此前见过的废墟不同，这些建筑保存得相当完整，大部分结构依然稳固，外墙几乎没有明显的损毁。然而整片区域却空无一人，死寂得令人不安。

初步的年代测定结果显示，这些建筑来自一个极为古老的文明，其历史甚至早于我们星球上迄今为止考古所能触及的最早记录。

仪器同时检测到了两种截然不同的信号——一种强烈而清晰，像是从整个星球各处同时广播的东西；另一种则极为微弱，像是被刻意藏在那道强烈信号的阴影之下，不想被人发现。
translation:
Our starship landed upon this immense planet.

As far as the eye could see, titanic architectural clusters stretched across the horizon—magnificent in scale and masterfully engineered. Unlike the ruins observed previously, these structures were remarkably well preserved; most remained structurally sound, their exterior walls bearing almost no noticeable damage. Yet the entire sector was devoid of life, steeped in an unsettling silence.

Preliminary dating indicated that these buildings belonged to an ancient civilization whose antiquity predated the earliest archaeological records known to our own species.

Our sensors detected two distinct transmissions simultaneously: one strong and unmistakable, as if broadcast planetary-wide, and another exceptionally faint, seemingly veiled beneath the stronger signal's shadow to avoid discovery.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗庞大的星球之上。

巨型建筑群延伸到视野的尽头，与我们在该星系探索的上一处遗址相比，这些建筑的风格有着明显的相似之处——相同的结构逻辑，相同的材料选择，相同的城市规划理念。但不同的是，这些建筑保存得更加完整，许多结构几乎完好无损，却同样荒无人烟。

仪器检测到了两种信号，一强一弱，弱的那个似乎在刻意回避被发现。
translation:
Our vessel touched down upon this massive planet.

Giant architectural complexes spanned to the horizon, bearing clear similarities to the previous site explored in this star system—sharing identical engineering logic, materials, and urban planning. Crucially, however, these structures were far better preserved, many virtually untouched by decay, yet just as devoid of inhabitants.

Sensors picked up two signals, one strong and one weak; the weaker transmission appeared to be actively evading detection.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球之上。

高大的建筑群将整片城区填满，规划整齐，布局合理，街道宽阔，广场开阔。大部分建筑保存得相当完整，许多甚至看起来仍然可以直接入住，只是整座城市空荡荡的，荒无人烟。初步测定显示，这些建筑来自一个极为古老的文明，历史远超我们已知的最早考古记录。

科研团队面临两个方向的选择。

一是深入这些保存完好的建筑内部，寻找这个文明留下的直接痕迹；二是架设设备，尝试解码仪器检测到的那道来自远方的强烈信号。

两个方向都有可能带来重要的发现。
translation:
Our ship landed upon this planet.

Towering edifices filled the entire cityscape—neatly planned, logically arranged, featuring broad avenues and expansive plazas. Most structures were well intact, many appearing habitable even today, yet the city was entirely deserted. Initial dating revealed that these buildings originated from an ancient civilization dating far beyond our earliest archaeological annals.

The research expedition faced a choice between two courses of action:

Either venture deep within these preserved structures to search for direct remnants left by this lost culture, or set up equipment to decode the strong, distant transmission flagged by our sensors.

Both avenues promised significant discoveries.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球之上。

眼前的建筑群与我们在这个星系上一处遗址中见到的风格高度一致，但保存程度远超前者——许多建筑几乎完好无损，外墙干净，结构稳固，甚至隐约可以想象出它们曾经使用时的模样。只是整座城市依然空无一人，安静得像是被按下了暂停键。

科研团队面临同样的两个选择：深入建筑内部，或者解码那道来自远方的信号。
translation:
Our ship made landfall on this world.

The architecture before us closely matched the style witnessed at the previous site in this system, yet its state of preservation was vastly superior—many buildings stood virtually pristine, with clean facades and solid foundations, allowing one to easily envision them bustling with life. Yet the city remained entirely empty, frozen in silence as if on pause.

The research team faced the same two options: explore the interior of the structures, or decode the transmission originating from afar.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了城市中央的一片空地上。

这是一座完整的城市——或者说，是一座曾经完整的城市的完整遗骸。街道、建筑、广场、所有的元素都还在，规划得井井有条，布局合理而成熟。建筑的保存状况出乎意料地好，大部分结构依然完好，门窗虽然残破，墙体却几乎没有倒塌。

只是空无一人。一个人都没有。

初步测定显示，这个文明的历史远超我们已知的最早文明记录。科研团队站在空旷的城市广场上，四下张望，仪器的读数显示整个星球范围内都充斥着一道强烈的信号，来源分散，覆盖面广，像是这颗星球本身在向外广播着什么。

这些建筑值得深入研究，而那道信号同样值得关注。
translation:
Our craft set down upon an open clearing in the heart of the city.

This was an intact metropolis—or rather, the pristine skeleton of what once was. Streets, edifices, and plazas remained in place, thoughtfully organized in a sophisticated layout. The state of preservation was remarkably high; most frameworks stood intact, and while doors and windows had deteriorated, the walls showed almost no signs of collapse.

Yet it was completely devoid of life. Not a single soul remained.

Preliminary dating indicated this civilization's age vastly surpassed our earliest known records. Standing upon the vacant central plaza, the expedition watched sensor readings indicate a powerful transmission permeating the planet—diffuse and wide-reaching, as though the world itself were broadcasting into the void.

These buildings warrant closer study, but the signal demands attention as well.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了城市中央的一片空地上。

与我们在这个星系探索的上一处遗址相比，眼前这座城市的保存状况要好得多，几乎可以说是完好如初。更值得关注的是，从建筑风格、材料选择和城市规划的逻辑来看，这两处遗址显然属于同一文明——同一个文明，在两颗不同的星球上，留下了两座城市。

整座城市空无一人，整个星球都充斥着一道强烈的信号。

这两件事之间是否有什么关联，目前还无从判断。
translation:
Our ship landed upon an open expanse at the center of the metropolis.

Compared to the previous site surveyed in this system, this city was in far superior condition—practically untouched by time. More intriguingly, the architectural style, material choices, and urban layout proved beyond doubt that both sites belonged to the same civilization—one culture leaving behind cities across two separate worlds.

The entire city lay barren, while a powerful signal washed over the whole planet.

Whether there is any connection between these two phenomena remains to be seen.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球的郊外，停在一座大都市的边缘。

俯视地面，城市的规划出乎意料地完整——街道笔直，街区方正，建筑分布均匀，一看便是经过精心设计的产物。只是这些建筑大多只比我们的科研人员稍微高出一些，站在其中，有一种奇异的压迫感，仿佛整座城市都在仰望着我们。没有一个人，所有建筑都已废弃多时，初步测定显示它们的历史远超我们已知的任何文明记录。

然而真正引起所有人注意的，是远处的那个东西。

在矮小的城市建筑群的衬托下，那座建筑如同一座拔地而起的山峰，遮住了一片天空。从外观来看，它像是某种宫殿或神殿，建筑风格与周围那些矮小的城市建筑格格不入——不是同一个尺度，也不是同一种语言，就好像有人把一座属于另一个世界的建筑，随手放在了这座城市的旁边。
translation:
Our vessel touched down on the outskirts of this world, halting at the fringe of a sprawling metropolis.

Looking down, the urban planning was astonishingly sophisticated—straight avenues, neat blocks, and evenly spaced buildings reflecting deliberate design. Yet these structures stood barely taller than our research staff; standing amongst them induced an eerie sense of grandeur, as if the entire city were gazing up at us. Not a living soul remained, every edifice long abandoned. Preliminary tests showed their age far exceeded any civilization on our records.

Yet what truly captured everyone's attention was an object in the distance.

Contrasting sharply with the diminutive city, that structure rose like a solitary mountain, blocking out the sky. It appeared to be a palace or temple, its architectural style clashing wildly with the tiny town around it—built on a completely different scale and speaking an entirely different design language, as though an edifice from another dimension had been casually dropped alongside the settlement.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球的郊外，停在一座大都市的边缘。

城市规划完整，建筑保存良好，大多只比科研人员稍高，整座城市空无一人。这些建筑的风格与我们在这个星系探索的上一处遗址高度一致——相同的结构逻辑，相似的材料工艺，毫无疑问来自同一个文明。只是那里的人们早已不在了，这里同样如此。

而远处那座如山峰般巨大的建筑，与周围的矮小城区形成了令人困惑的反差。它的风格与这座城市的其他建筑截然不同，像是另一种存在专门为自己建造的东西。
translation:
Our starship landed on the planetary outskirts, setting down beside a vast city.

The urban grid was intact and the structures well-preserved, standing only slightly taller than our researchers, yet completely deserted. The style mirrored the previous site surveyed in this system—sharing identical engineering principles and material crafting, unmistakably built by the same civilization. But just as the people there were gone, none lingered here.

Meanwhile, the colossal mountain-like structure in the distance created a baffling contrast with the low-lying cityscape. Its architecture bore no resemblance to the rest of the settlement, appearing custom-built for an entirely different kind of entity.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球之上。

俯视地面，那是一座规划极为精良的迷你城市。街道、广场、建筑，一应俱全，布局合理，只是所有的一切都不足我们科研人员的脚踝高。团队在行动时格外谨慎，每一步都经过仔细确认，尽管如此，仍有几处细小的结构在不经意间被踩坏了。

没有任何生命体征，整座城市废弃已久。初步测定显示，这些建筑的历史远超我们已知的任何文明记录。

远处，有一座与周围格格不入的巨大建筑。在这片迷你城市的映衬下，它如同山峰般耸立，从外观判断应该是某种宫殿。它的建筑风格与周围那些小巧的城市建筑完全不同，像是两个截然不同的存在，出于某种原因，被放置在了同一颗星球上。
translation:
Our expedition made landfall upon this planet.

Looking down at the ground revealed an impeccably planned miniature city. Streets, squares, and buildings were all present in immaculate order, yet none reached higher than our researchers' ankles. The team proceeded with utmost caution, carefully picking every step; even so, a few minute structures were inadvertently crushed beneath our boots.

No life signs were detected; the city had been abandoned for an immense span. Initial dating placed these structures far beyond any historical records known to us.

In the distance stood an enormous edifice starkly out of place. Towering like a mountain against the backdrop of the miniature metropolis, it appeared to be a palace. Its design had nothing in common with the delicate city surrounding it, as though two completely incompatible beings had, for unknown reasons, been placed upon the same world.

original:
我们的飞船降落在了这颗星球之上。

脚下是一座规划精良的迷你城市，建筑高度不足科研人员的脚踝，风格与我们在这个星系上一处遗址探索的文明高度一致。同一个文明，两颗星球，两座城市，却都空无一人，废弃已久。

远处那座宫殿般的巨型建筑同样格格不入，与周围的迷你城市形成了难以理解的反差。
translation:
Our ship touched down on this planet.

Beneath our feet lay an expertly designed miniature city, its rooftops failing to reach our researchers' ankles. Its style aligned perfectly with the civilization studied at the previous site in this system: one culture, two planets, two cities, yet both stood abandoned and devoid of life.

The colossal palace looming in the distance seemed equally incongruous, striking an incomprehensible contrast with the miniature city below.

original:
我们的研究人员降落在了这颗狭小的星球之上。

飞船无法停靠在城区附近——城市实在太小，降落产生的气流就足以将大片建筑吹倒。研究人员们徒步进入城区，每一步都必须格外小心，尽管如此，脚下依然不可避免地压碎了一些细小的结构。

城市规模庞大，规划完整，保存状况参差不齐——大部分区域相对完好，但也有一些地带有着明显的破坏痕迹，地面上留着某种规律性的压痕，像是某个巨大存在曾经在这里行走过。整座城市没有任何生命体征。

城区不远处，有一座宫殿。

它的规模远超研究人员们的预期，大门的高度接近千米，整个建筑的体量与周围那些细小的城市建筑完全不成比例。能够以这个尺度建造宫殿的存在，其体型约摸是我们的百倍有余。
translation:
Our researchers landed upon this diminutive world.

The ship could not dock near the urban zone—the city was so tiny that the thruster backwash alone would have blown entire districts away. Our crew proceeded on foot, picking every step with extreme care; nevertheless, fragile microstructures were inevitably crushed beneath their treads.

The city was vast in extent and fully planned, with varying levels of preservation: while most sectors remained relatively intact, certain zones bore severe signs of destruction, showing rhythmic depressions across the ground as if a colossal entity had once strolled through. Not a single life sign was detected.

Not far from the city stood a palace.

Its scale defied all expectations—the main gate approached a kilometer in height, and the structure's sheer volume was wildly disproportionate to the tiny city nearby. An entity capable of constructing a palace on this scale must have been over a hundred times larger than ourselves.

original:
我们的研究人员缩小后，降落在了这颗狭小的星球之上。

即便如此，行动依然受到了相当大的限制。脚下的城市群密密麻麻，研究人员们无法在不造成破坏的前提下正常行走，每迈出一步，都不可避免地踩碎了一些建筑。最灵敏的仪器扫描了整个区域，没有检测到任何生命体征——这里早已是一座空城。

城区的不远处，矗立着一座宫殿。

即便是缩小之后的研究人员，站在宫殿的大门前，也不得不仰头才能看到门顶——大门高约百米。这座宫殿是为某个体型约为我们十倍的存在建造的，它的建筑语言与周围那些超迷你城市截然不同，像是两个完全不同的世界被放置在了同一颗星球上。
translation:
Our researchers underwent shrinking before landing upon this tiny planet.

Even so, movement remained heavily restricted. The city complexes beneath our feet were so densely packed that navigating without causing damage proved impossible; every step inevitably splintered tiny buildings. Our most sensitive instruments scanned the entire zone, detecting no signs of life—it was long since an empty ghost city.

Not far from the city stood a towering palace.

Even in their shrunken state, our scientists had to crane their necks back just to glimpse the top of the portal, which stood roughly a hundred meters tall. This palace was erected for an entity roughly ten times our shrunken stature, and its architectural language diverged entirely from the ultra-miniature city surrounding it—as if two utterly separate worlds had been grafted onto one planet.
Attempt to receive the faint signal.
Attempt to receive the strong signal.
Investigate the mystery of the signal.
Explore the secrets of the buildings.

original: 小心地检查这些渺小的建筑。
谨慎地探索那个巨大的宫殿。
去探索那个巨大的宫殿。

经过反复处理，我们终于从噪声中剥离出了一段相对完整的弱信号。强信号的干扰始终无法完全消除，部分内容依然残缺，但大致的轮廓已经可以辨认：

“我们的余孤离开了曾经的家园。

那颗星球我们已经回不去了。新的星球更加寒冷，更加狭小，土地贫瘠，什么都要从头开始。我们几乎损失了全部的人口——那些数字我不忍心再写下来。但是，至少，我们有人存活下来了。

至少，还有人存活下来了。”

这显然是某种日记或编年记录的片段，作者不详，年代不详。信号还在持续传输，应当还有更多内容可以接收。
translation:
After repeated filtering, we finally isolated a relatively coherent weak signal from the static. Interference from the strong signal could never be fully eliminated and some parts remain corrupted, but the broad outline is identifiable:

"The remnants of our people have fled our former home.

We can never return to that world. Our new planet is colder, narrower, and barren; we must rebuild everything from nothing. We lost almost our entire population—numbers I cannot bear to write down. Yet at least... some of us survived.

At least someone made it out alive."

This is clearly an excerpt from a diary or chronicle, author and date unknown. The signal continues transmitting; there should be more to receive.

original:
经过反复处理，我们从强烈的噪声背景中勉强剥离出了一段较为完整的弱信号。干扰依然严重，相当一部分内容缺失，但残存的片段已经足以拼凑出大致的意思：

“我们的余孤离开了……家园，来到了一个更加寒冷、狭小、……贫瘠的星球。

我们几乎……了全部的人口。

但是，至少……存活下来了。”

语气沉重，措辞简练，像是某个人在极度疲惫之下写下的文字，没有任何多余的情绪，只是陈述事实。

这应该是某种日记或记录的片段。信号仍在持续传输，继续接收或许能够获得更多内容，尽管干扰消除的难度依然不容小觑。
translation:
Through iterative filtering, we managed to isolate a fairly coherent weak signal from the harsh background noise. Severe interference persists and large swathes are missing, but the surviving fragments suffice to piece together the gist:

"Our remnants fled... home, arriving upon a colder, smaller,... barren world.

We lost almost... our entire population.

Yet at least... survived."

The tone is heavy and sparse, reading like words written under crushing exhaustion—devoid of superfluous emotion, stating only raw facts.

This appears to be a fragment of a journal or official log. The transmission is ongoing, and continued reception may yield more content, though filtering out the interference will remain challenging.

original:
强信号的解码工作比预期困难得多。

信号本身并不复杂，但其中的文字经过了多层加密处理，使用的语言体系也与此前解码的内容有所不同，像是某种刻意为之的保护措施。经过大量比对和推断，我们勉强还原出了以下内容，其中仍有部分词汇无法完全确认：

“……

您的双眼……那双瞳孔。金色的，像是深渊的颜色，像是某种古老而可怖的东西凝视着这个世界。我第一次看到它们的时候，浑身颤抖，不知道是恐惧还是别的什么。

可以让我多欣赏一会儿吗？

……谢谢您。

不枉我从始至终，忠贞不渝。

我将永远追随您。”

科研人员们沉默地看着这段译文，没有人第一个开口。

那种语气很难描述——既像是虔诚的祈祷，又像是某种深入骨髓的恐惧，两者以一种令人不安的方式混合在了一起。
translation:
Decoding the strong signal proved far harder than anticipated.

The signal itself was straightforward, but the text had been subjected to multi-layered encryption, utilizing a linguistic system distinct from previous samples—suggesting a deliberate security measure. After exhaustive cross-referencing, we managed to reconstruct the following text, though certain terms remain uncertain:

"...

Your eyes... those pupils. Golden, like the color of an abyss, like some ancient and terrifying entity gazing upon this realm. When I first beheld them, I trembled from head to toe, unable to tell whether it was terror or something else.

May I admire them a little longer?

...Thank you.

My unwavering loyalty from beginning to end has not been in vain.

I will follow you forever."

The researchers stared at the translation in silence, no one willing to speak first.

The tone was difficult to define—resembling both a devout prayer and bone-deep dread, entwined in an unsettling harmony.

The strong transmission had undergone complex multi-layered encryption, and remnants of weak interference added further obstacles. The recovered text was incomplete, but its core message was clear:

May I admire them a little longer?

My unwavering loyalty from start to finish was not in vain. I will follow you forever, wherever you may lead me."

The tone of this text brought a hush over the research team.

The author's description of those golden eyes was tangled with an emotion hard to classify—reverence, terror, but above all, a suffocating attachment. It seemed far from healthy, yet was so visceral that no one could look away.

您的双眼。那双金色的瞳孔，我见过太多颜色的眼睛，却从未见过那样的颜色。那不像是任何普通存在应该拥有的眼睛，深不见底，像是某种来自更黑暗地方的东西。

可以让我多欣赏一会儿吗？

主人，谢谢您。

不枉我从始至终，忠贞不渝。我将永远追随您，无论您将我带往何处。”

这段文字的语气让科研团队陷入了沉默。

作者对那双金色眼睛的描述里，混杂着某种难以界定的情感——有敬畏，有恐惧，但更多的是一种几乎令人窒息的依恋。那种依恋看起来并不健康，却又真实得让人无法忽视。
translation:
Decoding the signal took considerable effort.

The strong transmission had undergone complex multi-layered encryption, and remnants of weak interference added further obstacles. The recovered text was incomplete, but its core message was clear:

"Master...

Your eyes. Those golden pupils—I have seen eyes of countless hues, yet never a shade like that. They do not seem like eyes any ordinary being should possess, fathomless, like something emerging from an even darker place.

May I admire them a little longer?

Master, thank you.

My unwavering loyalty from start to finish was not in vain. I will follow you forever, wherever you may lead me."

The tone of this text brought a hush over the research team.

The author's description of those golden eyes was tangled with an emotion hard to classify—reverence, terror, but above all, a suffocating attachment. It seemed far from healthy, yet was so visceral that no one could look away.

original:
科研人员攀上了一栋建筑高大的石阶，那些台阶显然是为比我们更高大的存在设计的，但保存尚算完好，足以支撑攀爬。建筑的大门早已损毁，残破的门板上布满了大大小小的破洞，科研人员们弯腰穿过其中一个较大的缺口，进入了内部。

根据室内的布局和残存的设施，这应该是某种政府机关建筑——办公区域、会议室的痕迹依稀可辨，尽管一切都已残破不堪。能够在如此漫长的历史中屹立至今，本身就是一件令人惊叹的事情。

最大的办公桌上堆叠着大量文件，大部分都已腐烂成难以辨认的碎片，稍一触碰就会化作粉末。然而在这堆残骸之中，仍有小部分文件保存得相对完好，字迹残破，但经过仔细处理，勉强可以推测出其大致内容。
translation:
The researchers ascended the towering stone steps of an edifice—steps clearly carved for beings taller than ourselves, yet well preserved enough to bear climbing. The main entrance was long ruined, its dilapidated panels riddled with fractures; ducking through a wider gap, the scientists entered inside.

Judging by the interior layout and residual furnishings, this was likely a civic administration building—remnants of office cubicles and conference halls were faintly distinguishable, dilapidated though they were. That it had stood through such immense history was astonishing in itself.

Upon the largest desk lay a mountain of documents, most decayed into unrecognizable debris that crumbled to dust at the slightest touch. Yet amidst the ruin, a small handful had survived comparatively intact; their script was faded, but with careful preservation, the general message could be deciphered.

original:
城市中心最高的建筑外墙斑驳，但结构依然完好。科研人员轻轻推开那扇已经破旧不堪的大门——门轴发出一声沉闷的呻吟，随即门就开了，像是在等待这一刻等了很久。

内部的格局一目了然，这是某种市政厅式的建筑，中央大厅宽阔，两侧是密集的办公区域。主要办公桌上陈列着大量文件，层层叠叠，经过漫长岁月的洗礼，大部分已经腐烂得几乎认不出原貌。

然而奇迹总是存在的。

在那堆腐烂的文件之中，有些纸张上的字迹奇迹般地保存了下来——也许是材质特殊，也许只是运气。经过仔细的处理，其中一部分内容仍然可以勉强解读。
translation:
The tallest structure at the city center bore a weathered facade, yet its framework was sound. A researcher pushed gently against the dilapidated portal; the hinge groaned sullenly before swinging open, as though waiting for this moment across the ages.

The layout was immediately recognizable as a city hall, featuring a spacious central concourse flanked by rows of administrative offices. Piles of paperwork lay stacked across the primary desks; under the unrelenting passage of eons, most had rotted past recognition.

Yet miracles still occur.

Amidst the decaying parchments, text on several folios had miraculously endured—perhaps due to exceptional materials, or mere fortune. Following meticulous restoration, portions of the text could still be read.

original:
科研人员穿行于矮小的楼群之间，最终找到了这座城市中最高、占地最广的建筑。

与周围那些低矮的建筑相比，这栋建筑的大门显得格外高大——科研人员只需微微俯身，便可以轻松钻进去，不需要任何特别的努力。内部空间宽阔，但对于科研人员的体型来说，活动依然受到了相当程度的限制，只能在不破坏建筑结构的前提下进行有限的搜索。

在大量腐烂的纸张堆中，科研人员找到了一些仍然可读的文件。纸张脆弱，需要格外小心地处理，但经过简单的加固和清理，其中的内容应该可以进行初步分析。
translation:
Weaving through clusters of diminutive buildings, the researchers eventually located the tallest and most expansive structure in the city.

Compared to the low-slung architecture around it, the portal of this building appeared conspicuously high—our scientists needed only duck slightly to pass through effortlessly. The interior was spacious, though navigation was still constrained by the team's proportions, limiting searches to maneuvers that would not damage the building.

Within mountains of rotted parchment, the team uncovered several still-legible documents. The pages were brittle and required ginger handling, but following stabilization and cleaning, their contents should be ready for preliminary analysis.

original:
对于我们的科研人员来说，逐一打开那些如同小盒子般微型的建筑进行研究，实在过于繁琐且容易造成破坏。经过讨论，团队决定将研究重点集中在规模较大的建筑上。

在城市中心，有一栋占地面积远超周围其他建筑的建筑引起了大家的注意。科研人员使用精密镊子和微型探针，小心翼翼地从那扇比指甲盖大不了多少的门缝中伸入探测设备，确认内部是类似于市政厅的布局。

在一堆腐烂成几乎无法辨认的微型纸张碎片之中，探针找到了几份保存状况相对较好的文件。由于体积极为微小，加之腐烂程度不轻，解析工作将会相当繁琐，但并非完全没有可能。
translation:
For our research team, opening and examining those tiny, box-like structures one by one was far too tedious and risked widespread destruction. After deliberation, the expedition chose to concentrate efforts on the largest structure available.

At the city center, an edifice far broader than its neighbors drew everyone's eye. Using precision tweezers and micro-probes, the researchers gingerly guided sensors through a door seam scarcely larger than a fingernail, confirming a layout resembling a municipal hall.

Amidst decayed micro-paper scraps, the probe retrieved several relatively intact documents. Given their microscopic size and severe rot, decoding will be laborious, but by no means impossible.

original:
科研团队来到了宫殿门前，所有人都沉默了片刻。

台阶。每一节台阶都有数千米高，整座台阶绵延向上，顶端消失在云层之中。在宫殿主人的眼中，我们大概和蚂蚁没有什么区别。经过简短的讨论，团队决定乘坐飞船沿着台阶攀升，最终抵达宫殿大门前。

大门的门缝足以让陆地行驶载具轻松穿过。

进入宫殿内部的瞬间，所有人都屏住了呼吸。

这里的奢华程度远超任何人的预期。每一面巨大的墙壁上都覆盖着精工细作的浮雕与壁画，线条流畅，色彩历经不知多少世纪依然鲜艳。台架上陈列着无数工艺品，每一件都镶嵌着闪耀的宝石，在微弱的光线下折射出璀璨的光芒。石像如山峰般矗立，栩栩如生，神态细腻，与废弃的年代完全不相称——它看起来像是昨天才完工的。

地面上铺展着华丽的地毯，绵延向内，宽度足以让我们的飞船在上面起降。团队不得不绕道而行，以免破坏这件显然无比珍贵的织物。

经过漫长的搜索，科研人员们找到了一间藏书室。

那里的文件保存得出奇完好，每一张纸张都有数千米长宽，展开来几乎可以覆盖整座城市。但扫描和解析并不困难——仪器的性能足以应对这个规模。
translation:
Arriving before the palace gates, the entire research team fell silent for a moment.

The steps. Each individual tier stood thousands of meters tall, the grand stairway ascending until disappearing into the clouds. To the master of this palace, we would have been indistinguishable from ants. Following brief deliberation, the team opted to board their shuttle and ascend alongside the staircase, ultimately reaching the main gates.

The gap beneath the portal was wide enough for ground vehicles to pass with ease.

The moment they entered the palace interior, everyone caught their breath.

The opulence here surpassed all imagination. Every colossal wall was adorned with intricate reliefs and murals, their fluid lines and vivid pigments defying the centuries. Pedestals displayed countless artifacts encrusted with radiant jewels that glittered even in the dim light. Mountainous stone statues stood lifelike and expressive, utterly at odds with the age of abandonment—they looked as though finished only yesterday.

Across the floor stretched an ornate carpet extending inward, wide enough for shuttles to take off and land upon. The team had to detour to avoid damaging such an exquisite textile.

After an extensive search, the researchers discovered a library chamber.

The records there were miraculously well-preserved, each page measuring thousands of meters across—wide enough to blanket an entire city. Yet scanning and analysis posed little problem; our equipment was well up to the task.

original:
台阶的每一节都有数十米高。

科研人员们费力地攀爬着，绕过了每一节台阶的边缘，才终于抵达宫殿大门前。大门本身无法打开——它的体量超出了任何已知工具的能力范围——但大门旁边有一个预留的通道，尺寸刚好足以让科研人员侧身穿过。

宫殿内部的景象让所有人都停下了脚步。

墙壁上的艺术作品气势恢宏，每一幅都足以覆盖一整座城市。宝石嵌在台架上的工艺品之中，每一颗都有建筑物的体量，在光线中折射出夺目的光彩。石像矗立在宫殿的各处，高度直抵穹顶，面容细腻，神态生动，历经不知多少年岁月，依然如同新作。地毯从脚下向深处延伸，远端消失在宫殿幽深的内部，尽头处透出隐约的光芒。

而在宫殿的正中央，矗立着一座雕像。

那是一个女性的形象，姿态优雅，神情淡然，俯视着整座宫殿。根据雕像底座上的铭文以及此前收集的信息综合分析，科研团队确认——这就是蕾恩娜。

没有人说话。所有人都站在那座巨大的雕像前，仰望了很久。

最终，团队继续向深处搜索，在宫殿的一角找到了一间藏书室。文件保存完好，每张纸有数十米长宽，扫描解析并不困难。
translation:
Each tier of the staircase stood dozens of meters high.

Scrambling painstakingly around the edge of every step, the researchers finally reached the grand portal. The door itself could not be opened—its mass exceeded the capability of any known equipment—yet an auxiliary passageway beside it was just wide enough for researchers to squeeze through sideways.

The sight within the palace stopped everyone dead in their tracks.

The artworks adorning the walls were magnificent in grandeur, each large enough to span an entire city. Gemstones studded across ornamental plinths each rivaled whole buildings in size, refracting dazzling rays through the gloom. Stone statues rose throughout the halls right up to the vaulted ceilings, their delicate expressions vivid and fresh despite the endless passage of time. A carpet unfurled beneath their feet into the shadowy depths, where a faint glimmer shone at the far end.

And at the very center of the palace stood a statue.

It depicted a woman—poised with grace, serene in countenance, gazing down upon the entire hall. Analyzing the inscription at the pedestal alongside prior data, the team confirmed: this was Rainna.

Silence reigned. Everyone stood before the titanic likeness, gazing up for a long time.

Eventually, the expedition pressed on, discovering a library chamber tucked into a palace wing. The documents were remarkably preserved, each sheet dozens of meters across, posing no issue for our scanning systems.

对于经过缩小处理的科研人员来说，这个高度依然需要费力攀爬。抵达大门后，科研人员们从旁边预留的通道侧身穿过，进入了宫殿内部。

宫殿的内部景象让所有人都停下了脚步。

墙壁上的艺术作品延伸到了视野的极限，线条精细，色彩历经岁月依然鲜明。台架上的工艺品每一件都有建筑物的体量，镶嵌其中的宝石在光线下折射出璀璨的光芒。石像遍布宫殿各处，高耸入顶，面容细腻，神态栩栩如生，与这座宫殿废弃多年的事实形成了奇异的反差——它们看起来像是昨日才完成的作品。地毯从脚下向宫殿深处绵延而去，尽头透出幽微的光芒。

宫殿正中央，矗立着一座雕像。

那是一个女性的形象，身形修长，姿态优雅，面容平静，俯视着整座宫殿。雕像底座的铭文经过比对，与此前收集的大量信息相互印证——科研团队确认，这就是蕾恩娜。

没有人急着离开。所有人都在那座雕像前站了很久，各自沉默地想着什么。

最终，团队继续向内搜索，在宫殿深处找到了一间藏书室。文件保存完好，每张纸有数米长宽。经过缩小处理的科研人员面对这些文件，反而需要仰头才能看清全貌，但扫描设备的性能足以应对，解析工作并无困难。
translation:
Each tier of the staircase was merely several meters high.

Yet for our shrunken researchers, scaling this height still demanded strenuous climbing. Upon reaching the entrance, the crew squeezed through a side clearance to slip inside.

The sight inside the palace halted everyone in their tracks.

Murals stretched to the edge of vision, their fine linework and colors remaining vivid through the ages. Relics on display stands each equaled buildings in scale, their inlaid gems catching the light with brilliant facets. Stone figures stood everywhere, arching to the ceiling with lifelike, delicate features that contrasted bizarrely with the palace's derelict state—looking as though carved only yesterday. A carpet stretched into the palace depths, where a subtle glimmer peeked through.

At the center of the palace stood a statue.

A slender, elegant woman of calm countenance, looking down over the great hall. Comparing the pedestal's inscription with previously gathered data, the team confirmed: this was Rainna.

No one rushed to depart. Everyone lingered before the statue for a long time, lost in their own quiet reflections.

Finally, the team pressed deeper inside, discovering a library archive. The documents were pristine, each page several meters broad. Looking up at these oversized folios, our shrunken scientists scanned them without difficulty, proceeding smoothly with analysis.

translation: It seems they were the final embers of a fallen civilization.

translation: It seems they were among the very few survivors of the invasion.

original: 看来她这是多少有点疯魔了。
translation: It seems she had gone somewhat mad.

original: 看来她非常珍惜宝贵的亲情。
translation: It seems she deeply cherished family bonds.

original: 都过去多久了居然还有能看的文件。
translation: After so long, it is amazing that legible documents still survive.
Good, let us begin the analysis.
Rainna, we have heard much of you.
Stranger, who on earth are you?

original:
信号中断了很长一段时间，然后重新出现，内容发生了根本性的转变。不再是那些沉重的历史记录，而是某种更加日常、更加平静的东西：

“我们在新的家园安定了下来。

最初的日子很艰难，但人们没有放弃。狩猎、农耕，一栋一栋的房屋被建造起来，围成了第一个村庄。孩子们在院子里奔跑，老人们在门前晒太阳。用不了几代，应该就可以发展成城市了吧。一切秩序都在慢慢恢复。

看来，我们成功逃出来了。”

然后是另一段，语气更加轻快：

“我们根据祖先从飞船上带来的资料学到了很多东西。农业技术、建筑方法、医学知识——那些资料是我们最宝贵的财富。食物开始充裕，市场开始形成，集市上的笑声越来越多。我们很快就能追上祖先描述中的繁荣了。”

然后是第三段，语气变得有些遥远：

May we soon set sail, and return to our former home.

Mr..."

经过对信号的深度解析与情绪模式还原，科研团队从这段严重受损的记录中，还原出一段近乎完整的场景片段：

浑浊的鲜血顺着额头缓缓淌下，流过眼角，划过苍白的脸颊，最终坠入脚下那滩已经发黑的血泊之中。空气中弥漫着铁锈般的血腥味。

镣铐碰撞的金属声与压抑的呻吟在死寂的空间里回荡，每一次呼吸都伴随着肌肉被拉扯到极限的湿润撕裂声。泪水从紧闭的眼中渗出，却不是为了疼痛，而是为了洗刷某种更深层的罪恶。

“大人，她要死了。”

“……”

“是，大人。”

她倒在地上，身上布满交错的刀伤、贯穿的创口与焦黑的烧灼痕迹。呼吸浅而急促，每一次起伏都牵动着尚未结痂的伤口。

一只长靴踩住了她伸出的手指。足趾缓慢而玩味地扭动着，骨骼碎裂的细微声响清晰可闻，像干柴在火中折断。她没有发出任何声音，只是在心底无声地尖叫。

“……请您惩罚我。惟有我对您的忠诚，可以洗刷我的罪行……但是，……”

信号在最后几个字处出现剧烈的频率抖动与失真，仿佛那句未说完的话，被某种更强烈的恐惧或渴求彻底打断。

科研人员在确认译文后，实验室里久久无人说话。那种将极致的痛苦与近乎宗教般的忠诚混杂在一起的语气，让所有人都感到一种难以言喻的寒意。
translation:
Through deep signal analysis and emotional profile reconstruction, the research team recovered a near-complete scene from the degraded records:

Turbid blood trickled slowly down her forehead, tracing past the corner of her eye, down her pale cheek, and dripping at last into the darkened pool of gore at her feet. The metallic stench of rust and blood hung heavy in the air.

The clatter of shackles and stifled groans echoed across the desolate chamber, every ragged breath accompanied by the wet, tearing strain of overstretched muscles. Tears leaked from her tightly squeezed eyes—not from pain, but in an attempt to wash away some deeper guilt.

"My Lady, she is dying."

"..."

"Yes, My Lady."

She lay collapsed upon the floor, her body covered in crisscrossing slashes, punctures, and blackened burns. Her breath was shallow and rapid, every rise of her chest jarring unhealed wounds.

A booted foot stepped upon her outstretched fingers. The toes inside ground down slowly and playfully; the faint crunch of fracturing bone rang out distinctly, like dry twigs snapping in a fire. She made no sound, screaming only within the silence of her mind.

"...Please punish me. Only my loyalty to you can cleanse my transgressions... But,..."

The transmission suffered violent frequency jitter and distortion on the final words, as if the unfinished sentence were cut short by an overpowering terror or yearning.

After confirming the translation, the laboratory fell into prolonged silence. That horrific fusion of excruciating agony and religious fervor chilled everyone to the core.

“是，大人。”

她倒在地上，身上布满交错的刀伤、贯穿的创口与焦黑的烧灼痕迹。呼吸浅而急促，每一次起伏都牵动着尚未结痂的伤口。

一只长靴踩住了她伸出的手指。足趾缓慢而玩味地扭动着，骨骼碎裂的细微声响清晰可闻，像干柴在火中折断。她没有发出任何声音，只是在心底无声地尖叫。

“主人……请您惩罚我。惟有我对您的忠诚，可以洗刷我的罪行……但是，主人……”

信号在最后几个字处出现剧烈的频率抖动与失真，仿佛那句未说完的话，被某种更强烈的恐惧或渴求彻底打断。

科研人员在确认译文后，实验室里久久无人说话。那种将极致的痛苦与近乎宗教般的忠诚混杂在一起的语气，让所有人都感到一种难以言喻的寒意。
translation:
Through deep signal analysis and emotional profile reconstruction, the research team recovered a near-complete scene from the degraded records:

Turbid blood trickled slowly down her forehead, tracing past the corner of her eye, down her pale cheek, and dripping at last into the darkened pool of gore at her feet. The metallic stench of rust and blood hung heavy in the air.

The clatter of shackles and stifled groans echoed across the desolate chamber, every ragged breath accompanied by the wet, tearing strain of overstretched muscles. Tears leaked from her tightly squeezed eyes—not from pain, but in an attempt to wash away some deeper guilt.

"My Lady, she is dying."

"..."

"Yes, My Lady."

She lay collapsed upon the floor, her body covered in crisscrossing slashes, punctures, and blackened burns. Her breath was shallow and rapid, every rise of her chest jarring unhealed wounds.

A booted foot stepped upon her outstretched fingers. The toes inside ground down slowly and playfully; the faint crunch of fracturing bone rang out distinctly, like dry twigs snapping in a fire. She made no sound, screaming only within the silence of her mind.

"Master... please punish me. Only my loyalty to you can cleanse my transgressions... But, Master..."

The transmission suffered violent frequency jitter and distortion on the final words, as if the unfinished sentence were cut short by an overpowering terror or yearning.

After confirming the translation, the laboratory fell into prolonged silence. That horrific fusion of excruciating agony and religious fervor chilled everyone to the core.

科研团队经过反复清洗与多层语言还原，从这些文件中剥离出以下几段恳求信息：

“尊敬的女神大人，我们已经派出我们的祭品，所有罪犯也已被押入刑场……”

“尊敬的女神大人，我卑微地请求您原谅我们的错误……”

“尊敬的女神大人，我们的人民正在遭遇饥饿的痛苦，现在街道饿殍遍野……您是否愿意施舍一些食物……”

这些信息的时间跨度似乎横跨数年。早期记录中仍残留着敬畏与讨好的语气，后期则明显转向近乎绝望的哀求。科研人员注意到，在这些恳求中，文明自身的苦难被轻描淡写，而对“女神大人”的尊崇却被反复、近乎虔诚地强调。实验室里没有人立刻开口讨论，这份“敬畏”究竟是发自内心，还是已被恐惧彻底扭曲。
translation:
Through repeated cleaning and linguistic reconstruction, the team extracted the following desperate appeals from the archive:

"Exalted Goddess, we have dispatched our offerings, and all criminals have been marched to the execution grounds..."

"Exalted Goddess, I humbly beseech your mercy to forgive our transgressions..."

"Exalted Goddess, our people are enduring the agony of starvation; corpses of the starved now litter every street... Would you deign to grant us a pittance of sustenance...?"

These messages appear to span several years. Early dispatches bore traces of deferential flattery, but later entries descended into naked, frantic desperation. The researchers observed that while the civilization's agony was downplayed, reverent adulation toward the "Goddess" was feverishly reiterated. In the lab, no one ventured to speak on whether this "reverence" sprang from devotion or had been grotesquely warped by absolute terror.
